records.name: Articos MCP
records.tagline: See how simulated buyers react, right in your agent
records.description: Most teams ship, then hope it lands. Articos MCP lets you check first. Right inside Claude or ChatGPT, run your headlines, positioning, or pages past simulated buyers based on your actual customers, and see how they respond before it goes out. Validated against human research from Baymard and Nielsen Norman, it agrees 86% of the time.

records.name: Takes for Mac
records.tagline: Record talking-head videos. Claude Code does the edit.
records.description: A free, open-source Mac app for talking-head videos. A teleprompter that follows your voice, one-button recording of camera and screen, and every take in plain folders. Claude Code, on your own Claude plan, cuts the edit, makes the vertical version and drafts the posts. Leave notes on the frame; it turns them into rules and remembers them.

records.name: PostNitro for Agents
records.tagline: Let your AI agent design and publish social posts
records.description: Most social APIs let an agent publish text or media it already has. PostNitro lets it design the post too. Connect from Claude or ChatGPT in one click (OAuth, no API key), or use our 35-tool MCP server, CLI or REST API. Your agent turns a topic, article or X thread into an on-brand carousel, image post or animated video, then schedules it to LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Threads, Facebook and Pinterest. Or it hands you an editable draft to finish.

records.name: Kai
records.tagline: Autonomous assistant designed to handle meetings and email
records.description: Kai is an AI executive assistant for solopreneurs, freelancers and startup founders. It works across your email, calendar and tasks: it triages your inbox and drafts replies, schedules around your availability, records and transcribes your meetings, then turns them into summaries and action items. Workflows run in the background, and Kai hands tasks to Claude or ChatGPT with the context of the meeting or email they came from. Web, desktop and mobile. Product Hunt sign-ups get 2x trial credits.

records.name: OpenWhispr for iOS
records.tagline: 100% open source, free & on device transcription
records.description: 100% open source, with local models that run on your iPhone or iPad. Transcribe on-device for free, without usage limits, an account or a subscription. Speak your reply, draft an email or capture an idea without uploading your audio for transcription. Download a model once and transcribe offline. Choose optional cloud processing or bring your own API key.

records.name: MentionBird
records.tagline: Ahrefs for AI Search
records.description: We took the top 3 Product Hunt launches and asked ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude the exact questions their buyers ask: “Best browser for Claude Code?” “How do I track agent run costs?” “Best open-source Grok alternative?” Nine answers. Zero mentions. AI sent their buyers elsewhere. That’s how AI search works. It pulls from pages it trusts—listicles, Reddit, comparisons, YouTube. If you’re not there, you’re not in the answer. MentionBird helps you fix that.

records.name: Fina Business
records.tagline: The flexible $20/mo QuickBooks alternative for founders
records.description: You started a business, not an accounting department. Fina Business gives founders the essentials of business accounting without the complexity of traditional tools. Track business and personal finances your way, automate invoices, accept Stripe payments, manage customers, and get double-entry bookkeeping, P&L, and balance sheets. Start at $20/mo and customize Fina around how your business actually works.

records.name: AdHelm CLI
records.tagline: An Open Sourced CLI for Managing Ads
records.description: AdHelm is a free, Apache-2.0 command-line tool that lets your AI agent connect to your own ad and analytics accounts, report performance, audit them, and recommend changes, entirely on your machine.

records.name: Mi Speaks 2.0
records.tagline: Books and PDFs read aloud by neural voices, on device
records.description: Mi Speaks reads your books, articles and PDFs aloud. 2.0 adds 28 neural Studio Voices, American and British, generated entirely on your iPhone: nothing is uploaded, and they work in airplane mode. Import a PDF and follow along on the real page with the spoken word lit, jump to any chapter, and prepare a whole document so it plays to the end with the screen locked. Free has no length limit; Premium adds Studio Voices.

records.name: Xiryn
records.tagline: The open-source personal agent that runs on your computer
records.description: Xiryn is a free, open-source personal agent that does what Muse, Grok Bot and Dots do — on your own computer. Each agent gets its own Linux desktop in Docker, so it browses, researches, codes and fills forms in the background without touching your screen. No account, no telemetry: your data stays on your disk. Any model, local ones too. Control it from anywhere through Telegram — approve payments with one tap or take over its screen from your phone. One command sets it up.

records.name: Remocn Studio
records.tagline: Ship a launch video without opening After Effects
records.description: A free, open-source macOS app where your own Claude Code, Codex, Copilot or Grok builds your video as a real Remotion project. Watch it change live, click any element to tune it, give notes in chat, export MP4 up to 4K. No timeline. No lock-in

records.name: Vincentt
records.tagline: Bring your ideas to life through the camera.
records.description: Vincentt is the fastest way to build and launch camera experiences on the web. Build with your own coding agent (Claude Code, or Codex) and our open SDK, preview live on your phone, then publish to a link anyone can open. No app store, no headset.

records.name: HarnessHive
records.tagline: AI-Native, Simple & Collaborative Wire Harness Design
records.description: HarnessHive is the AI-native design ecosystem for wiring harness engineers. Schematic, layout, BOM and a to/scale formboard, all in one live document. With an AI assistant that helps you at every step.

records.name: OpenFlowKit 2
records.tagline: Free, open-source diagrams you and your agent edit together
records.description: A free, open-source diagram canvas: MIT, local-first, no account, in your browser. One canvas, five ways in. Draw it. Write it as code, or paste Mermaid, D2 or Structurizr. Ask any of 10 AI providers, or a local model. Hand it to your coding agent: Claude Code edits the canvas you have open, live, over MCP. Or pull it from a GitHub repo, every arrow citing its file and line. The CLI checks drift in CI, so diagrams keep up with your code.

records.name: Servor
records.tagline: One console to run and monitor all your servers
records.description: One console for every server you run: web terminal, file editor, scheduled jobs, fleet-wide commands, 150+ install recipes, plus monitoring, phone alerts and status pages. No open port, and every command is signed in your browser.

records.name: Scape
records.tagline: Orchestrate agent fleets with custom tools built on macOS
records.description: A working example of a loop orchestrator: an AI agent that runs a fleet on a heartbeat, manages its own tickets table as memory, and surfaces bugs from the logs before anyone reports them.

records.name: The Drive AI
records.tagline: The AI agent that does the work on your files
records.description: Most AI tools can read your files. The Drive AI does the work after reading. One agent across Google Drive, SharePoint, OneDrive, Dropbox, your computer and your NAS. It organizes thousands of files in one prompt, finds duplicates, builds new documents like a closing binder from 20 PDFs, and runs routines on autopilot as new files arrive. It shows the plan first, waits for your OK, and every change can be undone.

records.name: Upsolve Row-Level Security
records.tagline: Data permissions your AI agent can't talk its way past
records.description: Row-level security enforced server side, before any query runs. Set rules from user and org properties, test them as any user, and deploy one agent to thousands of tenants. The agent never sees the rules, so it can't bypass them.

records.name: CLI Manager
records.tagline: Let one AI agent open and drive your other CLI agents
records.description: CLI Manager now has an AI Control API. Claude Code, Codex or any script can open sessions in CLI Manager, send prompts, wait, and read the screen - in terminals you can watch. Sessions an AI is driving turn green in the sidebar, the orchestrator gets a crown, and Disconnect AI takes control back anytime. Local only (REST + MCP on 127.0.0.1), off by default. Plus everything from launch #1: Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI in one sidebar. Free, MIT open source, macOS.

records.name: Google Fitbit Edge
records.tagline: Google’s smartest fitness tracker ever with 7-day battery
records.description: Fitbit Edge is Google’s slim, screen-based fitness tracker for active lifestyles and everyday wear. It has built-in GPS, over 50 workout modes, ECG, skin temperature, and up to seven days of battery per Google. It’s Fitbit’s first repairable tracker, with a replaceable battery. $179.99, pre-order now, on shelves Oct 27. Includes 3 months of Google Health Premium, which is needed for the Health Coach and Health Guardian.

records.name: Agent Craft
records.tagline: 100× your social engagement and leads
records.description: Agent Craft gets your whole team posting from their own social accounts, where posts earn ~7× the engagement of a company page. Each person answers a daily prompt with a 3-minute voice note or video. Craft turns it into native posts for 8 platforms, you approve them in one review queue, and they publish from each person's account. Comments and DMs from likely buyers are qualified and sent to your CRM. $95/month first teammate, $75 each after. 30-day free trial, no card.

records.name: vibesmonitor.com
records.tagline: The ops center for everything you ship
records.description: Vibesmonitor puts traffic, errors, user feedback and cookie consent for every project you ship on one screen, with an inbox of what needs you first. One script per site. Or ask Claude, Cursor or any MCP agent which project needs you today.

records.name: Genchi
records.tagline: Project delivery predictions, from the people doing the work
records.description: Genchi shows engineering leaders a prediction of which projects are heading for a missed deadline and which aren't, from the people doing the work. We've rebuilt it from the ground up. Team members vote with one anonymous click in Slack. Leaders see a combined score for every and trend in one portfolio view, so they know where to step in and which teams to leave alone. Genchi works with Jira and Asana. You can see your live portfolio inside Claude, ChatGPT and Grok. Free for teams of up to 10.

records.name: Toby
records.tagline: Realistic mock interviews with an AI hiring manager
records.description: Paste a job description. Toby researches the company, maps every round and interviews you on a Meet, Teams or Zoom-style call. Then you get a scored debrief and a stronger version of each answer, built only from what you said. Real mode runs it straight through; Coach mode gives a note and a retry. No subscription: 50p a minute on a call. First 5 minutes free.

records.name: MausBot
records.tagline: Open source Grok Bot: Free, Local
records.description: Give each bot a job and work with it in a familiar chat interface. MausBot brings your supported AI agents together on your computer, with tools and routines for getting work done. Free and open source under Apache 2.0. Bring your own provider account or API key; provider fees and limits apply.

records.name: Muse Wonder
records.tagline: Meta’s most capable models for personal agents
records.description: Muse Wonder is Meta’s new model series for personal and professional agents, with two models: Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full. Active Memory carries your context across conversations, Active Focus keeps working through blockers on hard goals, and it adds domain expertise in law, finance, and health plus stronger coding. Muse Wonder is live on the Meta Model API and Muse Code. Muse Wonder Full is for Muse Code subscribers.

records.name: OpenCode 2.0
records.tagline: The open source AI coding agent
records.description: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent. It’s available as a terminal-based interface, desktop app, or web app.

records.name: GotEmail
records.tagline: Native macOS mail app with one-click sign-in codes and AI
records.description: GotEmail is a native Mac mail app for people who live in their inbox. Gmail, Outlook, iCloud and any IMAP account in one fast window. Sign-in codes are one click away, AI drafts and summarizes when you ask. Pay once, use on every Mac.

records.name: Music Dawn
records.tagline: A recorder for musicians. Every idea sounds finished.
records.description: Music Dawn is a recorder made for musicians. Record an idea in one tap, hear it with a finished sound right away, and keep every take in one library on all your devices. iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch. Free, with optional Pro.

records.name: see.io
records.tagline: Describe your idea, get a live website in minutes
records.description: Type what you want, like a booking page for your barbershop or a menu for your cafe, and an AI agent designs it, writes real code, and puts it live in minutes. Edit by chatting, restore any version, own your domain and git repo. Free to start, $9.99/mo to host.

records.name: Eyevinn Live Encoding
records.tagline: Point OBS at a URL and stream adaptive HLS to a browser
records.description: An open-source (MIT) live encoder built on ffmpeg. Send RTMP from OBS and get a two-rendition HLS stream that plays in any browser. Run it yourself, or create it on Open Source Cloud, where the only required setting is a name and no code is needed.

records.name: Korea No Filter Trip Tools
records.tagline: Free tools that answer the questions Korea visitors ask
records.description: Korea No Filter is an honest, fact-checked guide to visiting Korea, run from Seoul. The Trip Tools answer the questions visitors get stuck on, in under a minute and with no sign-up: which transit card to buy (with the math), how much tax you'll get back on shopping, which Seoul neighborhood fits your trip, a pre-trip checklist, and Korean phrase cards to show a taxi driver. Every price and rule on the site links to its source and shows when it was last checked.

records.name: Neroidea
records.tagline: Free browser mini-games + an AI prompt gallery
records.description: Neroidea is a free collection of light browser games and an AI art prompt gallery. Play Soft Melon (a soft-body fruit merge with a knead mechanic), Magic Cube (3D Rubik Cube with a Kociemba solver and scramble timer), Daily Equation (a Wordle-style math puzzle, the same for everyone each day) and Flow Field (an ambient particle toy). The gallery pairs 800+ curated AI artworks with the full, copyable prompt behind each image. No installs, no accounts, bilingual.

records.name: InkCalc
records.tagline: Notepad calculator for Mac & iPhone with on-device AI
records.description: InkCalc is a notepad calculator for Mac, iPhone and iPad. Write math the way you'd say it (1000 - 20%, 5 km in miles, 100 USD in JPY, today + 90 days) and the result appears next to each line. Name values, reuse them with sum above or ans, and everything recalculates as you edit. Built-in AI turns plain words into formulas, fixes broken lines and summarizes a note, on-device with Apple Intelligence or with your own Claude or OpenAI key. Notes sync across devices via iCloud.

records.name: Volio
records.tagline: Guests order and pay from their phone. No app, no hardware
records.description: Volio is one ordering system for restaurants, bars, cafés and beach clubs. Guests scan the QR on the table, order in their own language and pay from their phone, with no app. Orders go straight to the bar and kitchen screens, and staff run the floor from their own phones. It works beside the till you already have, on phones, tablets and TVs you already own. The QR menu is free and stays free. Volio takes a small fee only when a bill is paid by phone.

records.name: Recoura
records.tagline: Recover the revenue your payment processor gave up on
records.description: Recoura recovers failed payments once Stripe and Square have exhausted their retries. It's an all-in-one solution for failed subscriptions, invoices, and one-off charges. Customers receive an invoice they can pay in seconds. Plus in-app banners, AI-drafted emails, and weekly churn reports. We're a Stripe Partner, listed on the Stripe App Marketplace.

records.name: Mad Chatter Live
records.tagline: Your @handle is a phone number you can publish.
records.description: Someone taps your @handle, your phone rings, you're on video. No app for them, no sign-up, no scheduling. And because anyone can reach you, you control who: screen first-time callers, set quiet hours, block silently. One link, published safely. Free on iPhone and Android, and calls are never recorded. Pro adds the screening controls, more handles and AI recaps of your call notes.

records.name: STM Journals
records.tagline: Discover, Publish & Share Peer-Reviewed Scientific Research
records.description: STM Journals is an academic publishing and research discovery platform offering scholarly journals across science, technology, medicine, engineering, and interdisciplinary fields. It helps researchers, academicians, and students explore scientific publications, discover relevant research, and share their scholarly work with a global academic audience.

records.name: Crumb
records.tagline: Open-source customer feedback, prioritized by revenue
records.description: Crumb is an open-source feedback tool for B2B SaaS. Customers send feedback from an in-app widget with their account attached; you see the ARR behind every request, push work to Linear, Jira or GitHub, and tell them when it ships. Self-host free or use Cloud.

records.name: TeamClu
records.tagline: Shared skills and group chat for your team's AI agents.
records.description: TeamClu is a shared workspace where your team and its AI agents work in the same group chats. Sessions are group chats, not 1:1 bot chats: add teammates, @mention people, branch an agent reply into a thread, and see who's online. Skills are team assets: publish one with a changelog and every teammate's agent follows it automatically. Edit locally and you get a conflict, never a silent overwrite. MIT, in beta.

records.name: CVBuild- AI resume maker
records.tagline: ATS-friendly resume in minutes.
records.description: Welcome to the ultimate frictionless resume builder. We format your details into premium, ATS-compliant layouts that recruiters love—no margin fighting required. 🚀 Why Choose Us? • Instant Impact: Get a flawless PDF in seconds. • The Layout Arsenal: Switch templates with a single tap. • Effortless Editing: Fix typos and regenerate on the fly. • 100% Free Export: No watermarks or hidden paywalls. Stop wasting time on formatting. Build your perfect resume today!

records.name: Sorexa CRM
records.tagline: Run Your Business Smarter with Sorexa CRM
records.description: Sorexa CRM is an all-in-one business management platform featuring CRM, POS billing, GST invoicing, inventory, stock tracking, customer management, sales, repair management, device buy & sell, staff management, reports, analytics, and multi-store operations. With our new Product Catalogue, businesses can create their own store pages, showcase products, and sell online. Simplify daily operations, manage your business, and grow with Sorexa CRM by Sorexa Technologies.

records.name: Phosphor
records.tagline: A free macOS terminal that runs your servers and AI agents
records.description: One SSH connection per host runs the shell, Docker, live metrics, SFTP and keys. Split a pane and pick with Tab what runs in it: a shell or a coding agent (Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, opencode) — no API keys, each agent in its own git worktree. A built-in MCP server lets agents use your servers under a per-host policy with an audit log. Profile sync through your own server, end-to-end encrypted. Touch ID. Free, MIT.

records.name: TinyPomo
records.tagline: Focus timer that builds a Moon base, one session at a time
records.description: TinyPomo is a Pomodoro timer for iPhone and iPad. Every focus session earns credits to build a living Moon base and uncover a silent signal that leads to Mars. The Moon campaign is free. No ads, no accounts, no tracking.

records.name: PluginPeer
records.tagline: Community-powered QA testing for WordPress apps.
records.description: PluginPeer is a community-driven QA platform where WordPress developers can test their plugins and themes with real users. Key Features: - Real-user testing for WordPress plugins and themes - Instant sandbox environments powered by WordPress Playground - Step-by-step QA testing with detailed feedback - Recorded test sessions and public QA playback - Credit-based community testing system - Bug detection and usability improvements

records.name: Cleanmail: Family Inbox
records.tagline: The family calendar that writes itself from school email
records.description: Cleanmail connects to Gmail read-only and turns school, camp, and sports email into one short digest, organized by kid. Your digest only covers the senders you pick. The dates go onto Google Calendar on their own, with two-way sync, so the calendar fills itself in. Up to 4 people share one household. iPhone only for now. Free for 14 days, then a monthly or yearly plan.

records.name: dood
records.tagline: joins your meetings and doodles your conversations, live
records.description: dood is a cure for word vomit. He joins your meetings and doodles your conversation, live, so everyone can follow along. Invite him to brainstorms and team meetings, or classes and coaching on Zoom, Meet or Teams. Make your meeting more memorable by dressing your doodz in custom outfits with your brand colours and logos. After the call, dood sends a mural to recap with your action points.

records.name: Dockhive
records.tagline: Sovereign Cloud Infrastructure for AI Era
records.description: Dockhive makes cloud infrastructure simpler. Deploy apps, host databases, run n8n workflows, and manage container-based environments from one platform. With HivePods for lightweight compute and Drone, our AI-powered DevOps agent, we're building a unified cloud experience that reduces infrastructure complexity and gives teams more flexibility over how they deploy and operate their workloads. Built for developers, startups, and AI-native teams.

records.name: GuestCam
records.tagline: One QR code, every guest's photos, a live wall. No app.
records.description: GuestCam turns every guest's phone into a camera at weddings, school graduations, parties and conferences. Guests scan one QR code and share photos and videos from their phone camera, with no app and no account. Photos play on a live photo wall on any screen, and everything lands in one album. Approve photos before they go up, uploads survive bad venue signal, no facial recognition, and family overseas can watch the wall live. Free for school events.

records.name: Funhouse: 10 Offline Games
records.tagline: Ten offline games in one app: Chess, Sudoku, Rebus and more
records.description: Funhouse is ten games in one app, all offline, no ads between rounds. Chess against a real engine, hand-drawn emoji Rebus riddles, Sudoku with four difficulties, Minesweeper, memory Pairs, Connect Four, block puzzles, the Echo memory game, Serpent, and the emoji merge classic. The Daily Five gives you five short rounds and one score out of a thousand. On iPad every game takes the full height with its controls in a rail beside the board.

records.name: UX Quest
records.tagline: Build the UX judgment AI can't replace — one quest a day
records.description: UX Quest builds real design judgment by doing, not watching. Each day, you get one product screen with something quietly wrong: commit to a decision, get an instant verdict, and learn the principle behind it. Five minutes, with XP and a streak. It goes beyond UX trivia into designing AI experiences people can trust, with an AI mentor that reviews your reasoning, not just your pixels. Try the first quest free, no account, from the homepage.

records.name: Nomad
records.tagline: Work in focused stretches. Rest on time.
records.description: Nomad is a free, open-source work/break timer for the desktop. Set work and rest durations, press Start, and it cycles until you stop it. Native notifications on every switch. Lives in your system tray and closes to tray instead of quitting, so you never lose a session. No accounts, no cloud, no analytics, no subscription. Settings are one JSON file on your machine. Built with Tauri v2, React and Rust. Windows, macOS and Linux.

records.name: Lumelar
records.tagline: The family organizer that shares the mental load
records.description: Lumelar is a family organizer for couples raising kids. Routines, tasks, shopping, vaccines, appointments, medication, family finances and goals live in one calm app, and you set who handles each area, so it is not all in one person's head. Snap a photo, upload a PDF or just speak: the AI assistant turns it into a task, appointment or expense. Gentle reminders respect quiet hours, documents stay in an encrypted vault, and grandparents get their own access. Web + installable app, 5 languages.

records.name: Leadlock
records.tagline: Voice agents that book into your clients' software
records.description: Leadlock is a voice AI platform for agencies and operators who set up voice agents for local service businesses. The agent answers the phone, qualifies the caller and books the job straight into the software the business already runs. GoHighLevel works out of the box, and ServiceTitan or anything else with an API can be connected. Self-serve plans start at $97 a month with a 7-day free trial, or Leadlock builds and runs it for you.

records.name: LostPage — Immersive 404 Pages
records.tagline: Turn boring 404 pages into interactive experiences.
records.description: LostPage is a free library of 666 immersive 404 pages across 116 creative scenes. Explore WebGL oceans, black holes, retro terminals, interactive animations, and playable mini-games. Built for React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, Angular, and plain HTML. Easily integrate and customize designs to transform boring error pages into memorable experiences. Free for developers, designers, and creators.

records.name: ScrollGist
records.tagline: Turn Reels and short videos into study notes
records.description: ScrollGist is a Chrome extension for learning from short videos. Open an Instagram Reel, a Facebook video or an X video post and click once: it transcribes the audio, then writes a summary, a plain-language Feynman explanation and an idea map of the concepts in a panel beside the video. 20 output languages. No analytics, no tracking. 15 videos free with no account; Pro is $6.99/month or $49.99/year.

records.name: Minimalist 20-Page Digital Notebook
records.tagline: A minimal 20 page digital notebook template for notes
records.description: Hey Product Hunt community! I designed this aesthetic 20-page digital notebook to solve a simple problem: clunky, confusing digital planners. It features a highly minimalist, clean layout that gives you zero distractions while tracking habits, taking class notes, or organizing your thoughts. It is fully optimized as a printable PDF and works perfectly across all tablets and laptop note apps. Clean, fast, and completely distraction-free!

records.name: Harf Be Harf
records.tagline: AI-powered SEO content generation platform
records.description: Harf Be Harf helps businesses, marketers and website owners create SEO-friendly content faster using AI. Starting from a topic or keyword, users can generate structured articles designed around SEO best practices, making the content creation process simpler and more efficient.

records.name: Prompt Like a Designer
records.tagline: Design principles that make AI output look professional
records.description: A book and free companion tools from a designer with 30+ years of experience. Prompt Like a Designer teaches the IMPACT method (Importance, Margins, Palette, Alignment, Contrast, Typography) and shows how to turn each principle into language AI image and layout tools can act on. Four real projects and a prompt, see, refine loop turn generic AI output into work you'd actually ship.

records.name: Solenor
records.tagline: AI due diligence for M&A teams, from Data room to report
records.description: Solenor helps M&A teams turn scattered deal documents into structured due diligence. Use AI to analyze data rooms, organize information requests, review financial evidence, and prepare deliverables. Built for Transaction Services and carve-out workflows, it supports professional judgment rather than replacing it.

records.name: Greenly VPN
records.tagline: 100% Free Android VPN focused on privacy and no-logs policy.
records.description: Hi 👋 I built Greenly VPN to provide a fast, solid secure, and 100% free Android connection for anyone who wants to protect their online privacy. Key Features: • High-Speed & Secure: Optimized global servers for seamless, fast streaming and browsing. • Strict No-Logs Policy: We never track, log, or store your browsing history. • 100% Free: All servers are fully open with no hidden fees or paywalls. 📥https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.greenly.vpn Would love your honest feedback! 🚀

records.name: Artes&Tramas 3D
records.tagline: Nuovo calcolatore per chi stampa in 3D
records.description: Ciao a tutti! Sono un maker e, per gestire meglio i costi delle mie produzioni, ho sviluppato **Artes&Tramas3D**, un calcolatore online pensato per chi stampa in 3D e utilizza Cricut. L'obiettivo è aiutare a calcolare il costo reale dei prodotti, considerando materiali, tempi di stampa, energia e margini, con funzioni per gestire anche il magazzino. Vorrei farlo provare ad altri maker, raccogliere opinioni e capire quali funzioni sarebbero più utili. Ogni suggerimento è benvenuto!

records.name: LaunchLens HQ
records.tagline: Privacy-first launch analytics with AI insights
records.description: One line of code. Know where your customers come from. Cookieless, privacy-first analytics without the Google Analytics complexity. Install in 30 seconds.

records.name: Back Pocket
records.tagline: Save Chrome tab groups with every tab's Back history
records.description: Put tab groups away and restore them later exactly as they were: same name, same colour, and every tab's Back button still working (up to 50 pages a tab). See every window, group and tab on one page or in Chrome's side panel, spot duplicates, and search every page in each tab's history. Restored tabs load only when you click them. Free, with no sign-up, ads or tracking. Optional Pro adds sync through your own Google Drive, daily backups and tab sleep.

records.name: Clausery
records.tagline: Fill Word templates in your browser, nothing uploaded
records.description: Clausery turns ordinary Word templates into guided questionnaires and assembles the finisheddocx in your browser. Tags like {client_name} or {#has_deposit}...{/has_deposit} become questions for dates, money, yes/no sections and repeating rows. Everything stays on your device and it works offline. 87 free templates (NDAs, contracts, HR letters, leases) work with no sign-up; Pro adds unlimited own templates, calculations, encryption and client intake forms.

records.name: Elyssian AI Hub
records.tagline: 8 AI models in one Android app — no subscription
records.description: Tired of juggling five AI apps and five subscriptions? Elyssian AI Hub puts 8 AI models — ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Llama — plus free image generation into a single Android app. You bring your own API keys (most have free tiers), so there's no subscription and no per-message cost. Your keys stay on your device. Perfect for builders, creators, and anyone who wants to actually use AI every day without the bill shock.

records.name: Bharat Travels Chandigarh
records.tagline: Premier Tempo Traveller in Chandigarh – Bharat Travels
records.description: Looking for the best tempo traveller in Chandigarh? Book luxury tempo traveller hire & rent starting @ ₹25/km or ₹5,000/day. 9 to 26 seater & Urbania tempo traveller in Chandigarh to Manali, Shimla & outstation tours. Instant booking: 9814111122.

records.name: MaxQua Store
records.tagline: Better Choices. Healthier Tomorrows!
records.description: We are committed to offering high-quality products from reputable, well-established brands worldwide. Our dedicated research team carefully evaluates leading brands within each product category, comparing their offerings based on effectiveness, safety, ease of use, quality, and value for money. For health-related products, we place particular emphasis on safety, product quality, and reliable supporting evidence.

records.name: TidyFiles 2.0
records.tagline: Track disk space changes and safely clean temporary files
records.description: TidyFiles 2.0 is a local Windows file organizer and cleanup tool. Track storage changes, analyze disk usage, review temporary files and caches before cleanup, find SHA-256 duplicates, locate large files, and preview organization by type. Empty folder and AppData inspection are read-only; personal files are never deleted automatically. English, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese. 7-day free trial, one-time purchase, no subscription.

records.name: FrameOn
records.tagline: Come with a story. Leave with a film.
records.description: FrameOn is an AI filmmaking platform for filmmakers, studios and brands. Start with your story, shape the script with Cue, lock your characters and locations so they stay consistent in every shot, see the price of each shot before it renders, review with your team, and deliver a finished film, all in one place. Built by a team with 17 years in production and VFX. Creativity is yours. The tools are ours.

records.name: FIYR
records.tagline: Budgeting and net worth app that projects your FIRE date
records.description: FIYR is a budgeting and net worth app built around one number: the date your savings could cover your spending. Link your accounts through Plaid (read-only) and FIYR tracks spending, budgets, recurring charges and net worth, then feeds those real numbers into a FIRE date that moves when your spending does. There's also a free FIRE calculator with Coast, Lean and Fat FIRE targets, no account needed. One plan, $8/mo or $76.80/yr, 30 days free.

records.name: ProX
records.tagline: Show what you can do. Share it on your terms.
records.description: Build your professional identity once, and let the right opportunities come to you. ProX is a profile backed by real proof of work: projects, screenshots, links. Tailor CVs, analyze skill gaps, track applications, and get matched to live jobs in Finland & the EU. Share through private links you control and revoke anytime. No age, gender or nationality asked. Free for job seekers. Recruiters: browse published profiles today; hiring tools are in development.

records.name: Wapes
records.tagline: Turn WhatsApp Web into an AI-powered CRM
records.description: Wapes turns WhatsApp Web into a powerful CRM for small businesses. Send bulk campaigns with safe sending limits, reply faster with AI, export your contacts to CSV/Excel, and track your daily sales activity — all processed locally in your browser. Built by a solo founder for SMBs that run their sales on WhatsApp. Free plan available. Stop switching tabs and sell where your customers already are.

records.name: Tacticam
records.tagline: Sport video analysis for amateur coaches, with just a phone
records.description: TactiCam turns the phones you already have into a team video tool for amateur coaches. Film a whole match on a tripod, or keep only the plays that matter, then review them : slow motion, drawing, player tags, comments, statistics. Clips go straight to each player's phone. Runs in the browser, any team sport, hosted in Switzerland. Free player accounts, 14-day coach trial, no card.

records.name: VolMix
records.tagline: Per-app volume and mute, right in your Mac menu bar
records.description: VolMix gives every Mac app its own volume slider and mute button in the menu bar. Keep calls at 100% while music plays at 20%, save volume scenes, switch output devices and use global shortcuts. No audio driver to install, no account, no data collected. 7-day free trial, then $4.99 once.

records.name: Lumina Atelier
records.tagline: Luxury editorial & architecture Next.js 15 + Figma template
records.description: Lumina Atelier (v2.0) is a multi-page architectural portfolio and digital flagship template built with Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion—bundled 1:1 with a native Figma Master Design System (.fig). Features 6 core templates (23 static SSG routes) including Works Archive, Case Study Detail, Studio Profile, Disciplines Matrix, Editorial Journal, and Interactive Inquiry Flow with AAA contrast & 100/100 Lighthouse performance.

records.name: CaseFinder
records.tagline: Check which phone cases fit your phone — 67 models, free
records.description: Pick your phone model and instantly see which case types and screen protectors fit it. Covers 67 models — iPhone 6 to 17, Galaxy S7 to S24 Ultra, Pixel, OnePlus and 7 more brands. Free web tool, no signup, no ads. The same dataset powers an open-source Python CLI you can script with.

records.name: AlphaGPT
records.tagline: AI powered SMC chart Analysis
records.description: Drop a screenshot of your chart. AlphaGPT reads it and lays out a clear setup: entry, stop, targets. Written to be followed without years of screen time. Connect your MT5 to place any setup in one tap, with the lot size automatically matched to your risk settings.

records.name: Vocafy
records.tagline: A music player for Vocaloid songs, from the original videos
records.description: Vocafy lets you listen to 20,000+ Vocaloid and other synth voice songs, organized by producer, voicebank, and year. Every song plays from the original upload on YouTube or Niconico, never a reupload. Continuous playback with shuffle, loop, a sleep timer, and a radio mode that keeps going with related songs. Titles shown in romaji and English. Favorites work without an account. English version: vocafy.kkweb.io/en

records.name: RaftOff Social
records.tagline: The Social Network Built for Life on the Water.
records.description: RaftOff Social brings boating, social networking, and lake exploration together in one app. Unlike traditional boating apps, users can check in on interactive lake maps, connect with nearby boaters, create groups and raft-ups, discover events, report hazards, and earn achievements. Our unique Ice Mode transforms the experience for winter activities like ice fishing, making RaftOff Social a year-round community built around life on the water!

records.name: Sponder
records.tagline: Your Support Inbox, Handled by AI
records.description: Sponder handles the repetitive emails that clog up your support inbox. It learns from your website, FAQs and policies, then replies to customer questions when it knows the answer. If it isn't confident, it escalates to your team instead of guessing. Use Pilot Mode to review replies before sending, or Autopilot to let Sponder respond automatically. Control when replies are sent for a more natural customer experience. Less repetitive work. More time for the conversations that need a human.

records.name: oldhint.com
records.tagline: Builder of OldHint.com — Timeless Tips
records.description: OldHint.com = Google for grandma wisdom that still works. Google gives 5-line AI fluff. OldHint gives full guides: Ingredients, 4 Steps, Why it Works, Mistakes, Video. 48 LIVE: biryani never sticky, roti soft 8hrs, dal dhaba, leaky faucet $0.50 fix, coffee stain 10sec, flat tire fast, 350 engine rebuild, envelope budget. Features: /explore, /search, SEO sitemap.xml, $7 ebook REAL Stripe sk_live checkout, 7 AI Agents. Built solo in Calgary T3J in 5 days. Try: search "biryani" vs ChatGPT.

records.name: Grab The Blueprint
records.tagline: urn service business ideas into build-ready blueprints
records.description: Describe a service business idea and get a researched 12-section blueprint with positioning, pricing, unit economics, staffing, technology, marketing, financial modeling, risks, and a 90-day launch roadmap.

records.name: InstantCVFit
records.tagline: Free AI Resume Tailor for ATS-compliant, keyword-matched CVs
records.description: Tailor your resume to any job description using AI to boost ATS compatibility while keeping your experience completely authentic. Key Features: • Grounded strictly in your real work history. • Client-side PDF parsing with multi-column support. • Choose between an ATS-optimized layout or a visual design. • Free tier: 3 guest API calls daily, and 50 daily with Google sign-in. Read the technical write-up: https://syedjamal030.github.io/work/instantcvfit/

records.name: Salari CV Scan
records.tagline: Free ATS check for mobile engineers' CVs, in your browser
records.description: Upload your CV as a PDF and see what an applicant tracking system can read: a score out of 100 across seven categories, the fixes that matter first, and how your skills match the role you are applying for. Built for iOS, Android and cross-platform engineers, by a staff mobile engineer who reads these CVs from the hiring side. The file is read in your browser and never uploaded.

records.name: Finerz
records.tagline: Spot subscriptions, fees and what's left to live on
records.description: Finerz reads your bank accounts (read-only, via Bridge) and answers three questions every month: what you pay in subscriptions, hidden fees and loans, what you really have left to live on after upcoming debits, and what is about to be charged. Alert 3 days before each debit, calendar of the month, official cancellation link for 86 merchants. Paid app, iPhone, France only.

records.name: BrandOps
records.tagline: Your entire operation. One dashboard.
records.description: BrandOps replaces the tool pile. Influencer CRM with per-creator ROI, Shopify order sync, content calendar, lead finder and cold email, invoicing, MRR tracking, SEO site audits and an Instagram DM inbox, all in one dashboard. 14-day free trial.

records.name: DashboardGPT
records.tagline: Ask Your Data. Get Answers. See the Insights.
records.description: Meet DashboardGPT - a smarter way to explore your data. Upload CSV or Excel files, ask questions in plain English, and turn raw data into interactive charts, metrics, and AI-powered insights on an infinite canvas. No complex SQL queries or manual dashboard building required. Designed for business teams, analysts, and decision-makers, DashboardGPT makes data exploration faster and helps you make informed, data-driven decisions.

records.name: NetCheckPro.online
records.tagline: Is your internet good enough for calls? Plain-English answer
records.description: Free browser test that goes past download speed: latency, jitter and bufferbloat, scored for Teams, Zoom, gaming, streaming and VPN in plain English.

records.name: SaveOnLease
records.tagline: Check CAM and NNN charges against your commercial lease
records.description: SaveOnLease helps commercial tenants understand what their lease says about CAM and NNN expenses. Upload a lease for a free preview, then optionally add an annual statement and supporting PDFs. The $49.99 one-time report compares readable billing details with extracted lease terms, checks visible calculations, and identifies records needed to verify potential discrepancies.

records.name: AI Prime Tech
records.tagline: API access for coding tools and AI applications
records.description: AI Prime Tech is an independent API gateway for developers. Connect supported coding tools and applications using a gateway URL and API key, choose prepaid usage or timed access, and manage access groups in one account. Documentation covers Anthropic-format requests and client setup. Models and request limits depend on the chosen group. Operated independently of Anthropic.

records.name: Gramly: Discover Local Places
records.tagline: Find what's open near you: fast, light, private
records.description: Gramly is a lightweight Android app for discovering local places. Search nearby restaurants, shops and services within your radius, switch between list and map, see ratings and Open Now status, and tap for directions, a call, or to share. Save favorites, get proximity alerts. No data collected.

records.name: PrepSync
records.tagline: Practice the interview. Prepare for the job.
records.description: Practice realistic AI mock interviews for any role, build a CV and cover letter tailored to the exact job you're applying for, and track your applications. For job seekers across Nigeria and Africa.

records.name: Retello
records.tagline: The easiest way for service businesses to launch memberships
records.description: Retello helps service businesses launch and manage customer memberships. Build plans with your own services and benefits, customize pricing by vehicle, size, or service, and let customers join through a branded storefront on your website. Collect recurring payments through Stripe, track benefit usage, and check members in from one dashboard. Already offer memberships? Bring your existing plans into Retello and make signing up easier.

records.name: NotchAbove
records.tagline: Everything you need, right in your Mac's notch
records.description: Most notch apps just show what's playing. NotchAbove lets you control it: switch between speakers and AirPods in one click, and set each device's volume before you switch. It also puts your day in the notch: join your next call, run focus timers, take eye breaks, keep notes and to-dos, and check your Claude Code and Codex usage limits. A little companion peeks out to keep you company. Works on any Mac, even without a notch. Pay once, no subscription.

records.name: Garage Guru
records.tagline: Find Garage & Estate Sales and more nationwide - with maps!
records.description: Garage Guru puts garage, yard, estate, church, moving and store-closing sales from across the U.S. on one color-coded map. Hunters: search by zip code, browse the list or map, and plan your route to hit every sale. Gurus: post your sale in minutes with up to 6 photos so buyers can find you. Advertisers: get your business in front of local shoppers, or go nationwide. Free for everyone until April 1, 2027!

records.name: Compath
records.tagline: The outdoor app to plan, explore and record your adventures
records.description: Compath is your all-in-one outdoor companion for hiking, cycling and skiing. Plan your adventures with the information that actually matters before you go, weather, snow, avalanche risk, water conditions, restricted areas and more. Discover 25,000+ trails, create or customize your own routes, explore detailed maps, and track your activities along the way. From planning your next adventure to navigating it safely, Compath brings everything you need into one app.

records.name: GameDropRadar
records.tagline: Track upcoming game releases and every delay
records.description: GameDropRadar tracks upcoming PC and console game releases, with recorded delays showing the old and new dates side by side. Follow games, organize your wishlist and backlog, and use countdowns, a release calendar, and optional email or calendar-feed updates. Release windows stay visible when an exact day is unknown. Available in English and Arabic. Free, with no paid tier or card required.

records.name: Pulse Analytics
records.tagline: Cookie-free web analytics with uptime, speed & search data
records.description: Pulse Analytics puts traffic, uptime, performance and Google Search Console data in one dashboard, without cookies. No fingerprinting, no personal data stored, and a script under 3 KB. Built in Belgium, hosted in Switzerland. The dashboard and tracking script are open source (AGPL). Read your numbers through the public API, the CLI, or the MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor. Free for one site up to 5,000 pageviews a month, with every feature on every plan.

records.name: FaceFinder: AI Face Search
records.tagline: FaceFinder: AI Face Search helps you search by face
records.description: FaceFinder: AI Face Search helps you search by face instead of by name. Choose one photo, and FaceFinder uses AI face recognition to find similar face matches across public web pages and public social profiles, then ranks every result by how closely it resembles your photo. Checking if a photo has been reused on another site? FaceFinder runs a reverse image search and face search across publicly available sources to discover where a photo appears online.

records.name: DockTerm
records.tagline: Answer Claude Code prompts from your Mac notch
records.description: DockTerm wraps your real Claude Code session in a desktop terminal. munu, a small face in the Mac notch (a pill on Windows and Linux), shows Claude's permission prompts over any app, even fullscreen ones, so you answer without switching windows. Also: live subagent view, diff review, simple Git, split panes. Free, MIT, local only: no account, no telemetry. macOS, Windows, Linux.

records.name: QuickPaste
records.tagline: Save time typing repetitive texts with 1-click snippets
records.description: Crea plantillas de texto personalizadas con variables dinámicas y rellénalas en segundos usando Tab. Ahorra tiempo en Gmail, WhatsApp Web y cualquier página de Chrome con QuickPaste.

records.name: Parser
records.tagline: A real Debian IDE on Android that syncs with your PC
records.description: Solo dev from Brazil. Parser is a real Debian (stable-slim, arm64) on Android via PRoot, no root needed. You get a working terminal with apt (git, nano, node 22, adb preinstalled), a code editor, and two-way sync with your PC. Same Wi-Fi: direct. Away from home: encrypted relay. Conflicts become a conflict screen, never a silent merge. Pairing is a QR scan. The hardest part was keeping the terminal alive: Android kills background processes differently on every phone. Free on the Play Store.

records.name: PippyLog
records.tagline: The trading journal that checks you follow your own plan
records.description: PippyLog syncs your MT5 trades automatically, grades every trade A+/A/B against your own playbook, and warns you before you break your rules: minimum R:R, news blackouts, invalidation. Works with any strategy. Built for prop-firm traders.

records.name: Delightful Cells
records.tagline: Run AI on thousands of spreadsheet rows, reliably
records.description: Your colleague sends you a messy spreadsheet. Tidying it up means reading each row and making a judgment. Delightful Cells applies LLM reasoning to every row from a plain-language instruction, with automatic retries and saved progress when things go wrong. Lightweight, easy to use, and built to make spreadsheet work a little more delightful. Upload Excel or CSV, say what you need, and download the result.

records.name: Texas Road House Menu
records.tagline: Your Quick Guide to the Texas Roadhouse Menu.
records.description: Find Texas Roadhouse menu prices, restaurant hours, locations, popular meals, steak and rib options, and useful details for planning your next visit.

records.name: The Dev Summary
records.tagline: Daily tech news curated for developers & engineers
records.description: Daily tech news summaries, editorial dispatches, and curated updates for developers, engineers, and tech enthusiasts. Stay ahead with The Dev Summary.

records.name: Wastelesspantry
records.tagline: Smart stocks. less waste, save money
records.description: Wastelesspantry can be used via a desktop, via a smartphone and is also integrated with Amazon Alexa voice assistants. It helps manage your household pantry, covering food items in the cupboard, fridge and freezer. I created the software to help manage resources more effectively, avoiding unnecessary waste by keeping track of use-by dates and quantities, helping to create shopping lists, and even encouraging the use of products nearing their use-by dates through specially created recipes.

records.name: Shopxare
records.tagline: Free live chat, AI agent & help desk for websites and SaaS
records.description: Shopxare is a free customer messaging platform for websites, online stores and SaaS products. A fast chat widget that also works inside your app and knows your signed-in users, Are AI (an AI agent that answers only from your own content, with sources, and hands over to a person when unsure), a shared inbox for chat, email and Telegram, email tickets and a help center. One plan, and it's free: no credit card, no trial clock. 8 languages, with iOS, Android, Mac and Windows apps.

records.name: Lorekeeper - Voice Assistant For Games
records.tagline: Requires Claude Code
records.description: Lorekeeper is a voice companion for PC games. Hold a key, ask out loud, hear the answer. Lore, quest help, item facts and clips, just by asking out loud. It knows the game you're in, sees your screen, and never spoils what's ahead.

records.name: Git Receipts — your year, on paper
records.tagline: Turn your GitHub year into a receipt worth keeping
records.description: Your GitHub contribution graph, turned into something you can keep. Enter a public GitHub username or profile link, choose a year, and watch a thermal-style printer feed out your receipt. See contributions, active days, streaks, best month, and longest break, with an optional achievement stamp and a scannable QR code. Download PNG, PDF, or SVG, copy the text, or embed it in your README. Free, open source, and no sign-in required. Missing data is never guessed.

records.name: COSTA
records.tagline: Work. Rewired|
records.description: COSTA is a Deep Context Model — a personal chief of staff built around your actual work, your actual history, and the actual people you work with. It works with you throughout the entire day — from a personal podcast briefing before you sit down at your desk in the morning, through every meeting and decision. Your trusted collaborator on the complex work that actually matters.

records.name: Disc Golf Draw
records.tagline: Review your disc golf throws, frame by frame
records.description: Disc Golf Draw helps players and coaches study throws on iPhone and iPad. Record or import a clip, slow it down, step through each frame, and draw lines or angles on the video. Compare two throws side by side, add voice notes and tags, and share annotated clips. Pay once for every tool, with no subscription, ads, or account. Videos and analysis stay on your device unless you choose to share them.

records.name: HeightCanvas
records.tagline: Compare Your Height with Friends and Celebrities
records.description: Compare the height of two or more people, celebrities, or objects side by side with a free interactive height difference generator. Try it now!

records.name: Vidu Q4
records.tagline: Create cinematic AI videos with images and native audio
records.description: Vidu Q4 is an AI video generation tool that transforms images and creative ideas into cinematic videos. Create 3–16 second clips using a single image or up to 15 reference images and 3 voice clips. With native audio generation and up to 4K output, Vidu Q4 helps creators produce product videos, animated scenes, social media content, and visual storytelling projects with greater creative control.

records.name: Sablora
records.tagline: European compliant e-invocing for small businesses
records.description: Recurring invoicing for EU freelancers. Set client, amount and cadence once; Sablora applies the right VAT per country, including reverse charge, and sends a Factur-X e-invoice that passes EN 16931 validation. Clients confirm payment in one click.

records.name: GlobalBenefits Next-Step Check
records.tagline: Official U.S. benefits routes and next steps in 60 seconds
records.description: Find your next U.S. benefits step in three questions. Choose your state, the help you need and your application stage to get official routes and a practical action plan for food, health, housing, energy or cash assistance. Save the plan on your device or download it. Free, no signup, and no income or identity details required. Independent of government agencies; guidance only, not an eligibility decision or payment estimate.

records.name: Seedance 3.0
records.tagline: AI Video Generator
records.description: Seedance 3.0 is an AI video generator that transforms static images into engaging, high-quality videos. Key Features: • Image-to-Video Generation: Instantly animate any photo into dynamic video clips. • Viral Hug & Kiss Effects: Generate realistic hug and kiss motion effects between photos. • Creative Motion & Style FX: Easily apply fun visual distortion and stylized camera motions to your images. Bring your static photos to life with seamless AI video rendering in seconds!

records.name: Swiftly
records.tagline: Turn ideas and footage into publish-ready videos with AI
records.description: Swiftly is a conversation-first AI video creative partner. Start with an idea, photos, clips, product shots or references; shape the story, scenes, captions and style through chat, then review and export a publish-ready video.

records.name: AgentCodec
records.tagline: Combine cheaper models to rival frontier LLMs and VLMs
records.description: AgentCodec combines any mix of LLMs and VLMs, hosted or open-weight, using techniques inspired by communication theory and more: retry with feedback, add redundancy, merge several outputs. Even two open-weight models combined clearly improve benchmark results. Evaluate 28 techniques on your own data, then a router picks the model and technique for each request, with one knob for cost vs. quality. One OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Built on our NeurIPS 2026 paper, and extended since.

records.name: Calendar Widgets Suite
records.tagline: Your calendar on the Home Screen — no app to open
records.description: Eleven Home Screen widgets that show your schedule at a glance: a month with event titles, 1–4 weeks, an hour-by-hour timeline, today, and your Reminders. Six skins, your colors. Events never leave your device. Month is free; the rest is a one-time unlock.

records.name: Clio: Learn AI in Arabic
records.tagline: Learn AI in Arabic, with a Prompt Lab that grades your work
records.description: Clio in Arabic teaches practical AI skills in short, hands-on lessons written for the Gulf, not translated. The Prompt Lab gives you a real job and you build the prompt line by line from tiles you tap; it is scored out of 100 next to what a professional would send. An Arabic AI Model Guide tells you which model to use for writing, coding, research, images or video, and why, kept current as models launch. Finish a course and get a certificate with your name on it.

records.name: Somora
records.tagline: Create AI songs from your ideas or original lyrics
records.description: Somora turns musical ideas or original lyrics into vocal songs and instrumentals. Start with a simple description or use advanced controls for style, singing language, duration, BPM and key. Keep creations in a personal library and download FLAC audio. The regular free plan allows up to 3 songs per day, each up to 90 seconds. Available in English, Portuguese and Spanish, with optional lyric assistance and an experimental own-voice reference feature.

records.name: HugeTen
records.tagline: Only 10 featured spots in every city and category
records.description: HugeTen is a global discovery and advertising platform with only 10 Crown positions per city and category. Businesses, creators, and sports clubs can claim or bid for a Crown to gain a featured position, a public profile, photos, business details, Google Maps and booking links, announcements, and access to local City Boards. Visitors can discover businesses, creators, sports clubs, and local community content. 👑 HugeTen — Be One of the Ten.

records.name: File2File
records.tagline: Convert, compress and edit files right in your browser
records.description: 248 file conversions across 132 formats, 16 compressors, 7 PDF tools, OCR and an audio trimmer. Drop any file and it shows what you can do with it. Batch convert and download as ZIP. Free, no account, files are not uploaded. 37 languages.

records.name: Dotcomcreativez
records.tagline: Digital marketing agecy in thrissur
records.description: Dotcom Creativez is a results-driven best digital marketing agency in Thrissur. We help businesses grow through strategies

records.name: SpecGen
records.tagline: Annotate designs in Photoshop with one click
records.description: SpecGen is a Photoshop plugin that adds dimensions, spacing, coordinates, HEX color values, text properties and notes right beside your design, so handoff is clear without manual measuring. Select a layer, click an annotation, done. Works on macOS (Apple Silicon native) and Windows with Photoshop 25.0+. $4.99 one-time with lifetime updates, 7-day free trial, no card required.

records.name: Pro360 Real Estate Software
records.tagline: All-in-one real estate software for Dubai and the UAE
records.description: Pro360 brings the whole real estate business into one platform built for Dubai and the UAE. CRM and sales, property and facilities management, contracting, finance with UAE VAT and e-invoicing support, budgeting, fixed assets, inventory and purchasing, and HR and payroll all work together, so teams stop juggling separate systems. It also serves real estate companies in Bahrain and Riyadh.

records.name: AI Operator's Build Your AI Second Brain
records.tagline: Turn your notes into a searchable second brain with AI
records.description: Turn your AI assistant into a true second brain: this playbook gives you three proven free stack options, a 5-minute daily capture workflow for notes, articles, PDFs, and podcasts, 8 copy-paste summarization prompts, a retrieval-ready tagging system, 4 retrieval prompts (including 'what did I think about X?'), a 30-minute weekly synthesis ritual, and a 15-minute monthly maintenance routine. Tool-agnostic across ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. ~3 hours to build, under 5 minutes a day to maintain.

records.name: Arogyam AI Dentist Lite
records.tagline: Understand your oral health with AI-powered dental insights.
records.description: AI Dentist helps you track oral health with AI-powered visual assessments. Upload teeth photos to receive easy-to-understand observations and reports. Chat about dental care, connect with dentists, book appointments, share reports, access oral hygiene tips, and manage family dental records securely. Disclaimer: For educational and informational purposes only. AI observations may be inaccurate and are not a diagnosis. Consult a qualified dentist for professional advice.

records.name: Growo
records.tagline: Is your baby growing right? Built by a physician
records.description: Parents google "is my baby's weight normal?" at 3am and land on scary forums. Growo turns weight, height and head size into clear percentile charts and plain-language answers, built by a physician. Track growth, sleep, feeding and milestones in one place, share records with both parents, and bring a clean report to every check-up. Free growth calculators and guides in 17 languages at usegrowo.com.

records.name: CouchPotato
records.tagline: Discover, Track and Rate movies/shows with friends
records.description: CouchPotato helps you discover new movies, track them, manage watchlists, rate favorites, and share viewing activity with friends.

records.name: DeskBot
records.tagline: The trading desk for Kalshi's 15-minute markets
records.description: DeskBot watches all 19 Kalshi 15-minute markets at once, does the break-even math after fees every round, and trades your own account only when your rules say go. Every trade and skip comes with a written reason. Runs on your computer with your own API key, so your money never leaves your Kalshi account. $19.99/month, cancel anytime. Trading can lose money; not financial advice. Not affiliated with Kalshi.

records.name: Veyra - Decide - legal- general - model
records.tagline: Sota - legal decision model with general capabilities
records.description: Introducing Veyra-Decide by JudicialMind - a family of 0.6B, 2B, 4B, 9B, and 27B decision models designed for legal and general-purpose reasoning. Explore different model sizes to find the right balance of reasoning capability, speed, and compute requirements. Built for developers and researchers to evaluate, experiment, and build real-world applications. ( Sota capabilities in legal and general )

records.name: Trawex Sightseeing API
records.tagline: Expand your travel product portfolio with sightseeing option
records.description: Trawex Sightseeing API helps travel businesses integrate sightseeing tours, tourist attractions, excursions, and activities into their online travel booking platforms. Through API integration, travel businesses can connect with supported sightseeing suppliers and streamline the discovery and booking of travel activities, subject to available supplier features.

records.name: Linesmith
records.tagline: Subtitle, translate and dub videos on your own computer
records.description: Found the video you need, but it's in a language you don't speak? Linesmith turns the speech into subtitles, translates them into 33 languages and can dub it with AI voices. Windows and Linux, your own AI key, no minute counter. First 3 videos free.

records.name: Simrix Monitor
records.tagline: Real browser checks on critical conversion paths with alerts
records.description: Simrix Monitor is a no-code website monitoring tool that runs real browser checks on critical flows like checkout, login and signup, detects meaningful page changes, and alerts small businesses and agencies with screenshots and plain-English summaries.

records.name: Flicka
records.tagline: Iran's Equestrian Social Network & Marketplace
records.description: Flicka brings the equestrian community together in one platform by combining a social network with a dedicated marketplace for riding products. Riders and horse owners can create profiles, discover products, connect with the community, and explore equestrian businesses and services. records.description: Tabulens opens tables that Excel can't or that online viewers want you to upload: DBF (dBase, FoxPro, Clipper), Excel, CSV, Parquet, SQLite, Access, SPSS, Stata, SAS and tables inside ZIP archives. records.name: ShoppingList

records.name: SteadyEdit

records.name: Hostsy
records.tagline: Digital guest guides for short-term rentals
records.description: Give guests Wi-Fi details, house instructions and local recommendations through one link or QR code. Hostsy helps short-term rental hosts keep property information organized and accessible. No app needed for guests.

records.name: Chahiya

records.description: Chahiya is an all-in-one food ordering and restaurant operating platform built to eliminate third-party marketplace commissions. records.name: Septimius AI

No more searching for the latest version of what you're working on and editing across 8 different tools (Word, Lucid, Miro, Visio, Claude, Gemini, Deepseek, Kimi, etc). records.name: MapNero

records.name: VulnCue
records.tagline: Real CVE data for your WordPress plugins, plus built-in 2FA

Start free with monthly scans on one site, or upgrade for continuous monitoring, PDF reports, and white-label plans built for agencies managing multiple WordPress sites for clients.

records.name: ZenMed

Specialty modules for gynecology, dentistry and psychotherapy. Public pricing with a Free plan; paid plans from USD 49 net per specialist per month, and front-desk accounts are free.

records.name: Piece World

records.name: Tracked

records.description: Track workouts, RIR, personal records and nutrition in one app. Build programs, scan food barcodes and review progress. Core tracking is free, with optional Pro tools, offline workouts and a web dashboard for coaches. Available on iOS and Android.

Free account, from $15.99/mo, cancel anytime.

records.name: Sfumo

records.name: ClavierVirtuel - Online virtual keyboard

records.name: Pairo

records.name: FaithPulse AI

A reminder 48 hours before a trial ends and 3 days before every renewal.

records.name: Futurionex

records.description: Futurionex is a global multi-asset CFD trading platform. records.name: K-ode

Build with visual tools, extend functionality with code, and use an AI assistant to speed up development. Publish your projects across multiple platforms without managing separate development workflows.

records.name: VDO Product Video Feed

records.name: BeatLock
