records.name: Remocn Studio
records.tagline: Ship a launch video without opening After Effects
records.description: A free, open-source macOS app where your own Claude Code, Codex, Copilot or Grok builds your video as a real Remotion project. Watch it change live, click any element to tune it, give notes in chat, export MP4 up to 4K. No timeline. No lock-in

records.name: Vincentt
records.tagline: Bring your ideas to life through the camera.
records.description: Vincentt is the fastest way to build and launch camera experiences on the web. Build with your own coding agent (Claude Code, or Codex) and our open SDK, preview live on your phone, then publish to a link anyone can open. No app store, no headset.

records.name: HarnessHive
records.tagline: AI-Native, Simple & Collaborative Wire Harness Design
records.description: HarnessHive is the AI-native design ecosystem for wiring harness engineers. Schematic, layout, BOM and a to/scale formboard, all in one live document. With an AI assistant that helps you at every step.

records.name: OpenFlowKit 2
records.tagline: Free, open-source diagrams you and your agent edit together
records.description: A free, open-source diagram canvas: MIT, local-first, no account, in your browser. One canvas, five ways in. Draw it. Write it as code, or paste Mermaid, D2 or Structurizr. Ask any of 10 AI providers, or a local model. Hand it to your coding agent: Claude Code edits the canvas you have open, live, over MCP. Or pull it from a GitHub repo, every arrow citing its file and line. The CLI checks drift in CI, so diagrams keep up with your code.

records.name: Product specification CSV check
records.tagline: Compare product CSVs by SKU in your browser
records.description: Compare two product CSVs by SKU to spot missing products and changed specs. Free browser-based demo with English/Japanese UI, a fixed six-column template, and up to 100 rows per file. CSV contents are processed locally. No account or payment.

records.name: Servor
records.tagline: One console to run and monitor all your servers
records.description: One console for every server you run: web terminal, file editor, scheduled jobs, fleet-wide commands, 150+ install recipes, plus monitoring, phone alerts and status pages. No open port, and every command is signed in your browser.

records.name: Scape
records.tagline: Orchestrate agent fleets with custom tools built on macOS
records.description: A working example of a loop orchestrator: an AI agent that runs a fleet on a heartbeat, manages its own tickets table as memory, and surfaces bugs from the logs before anyone reports them.

records.name: The Drive AI
records.tagline: The AI agent that does the work on your files
records.description: Most AI tools can read your files. The Drive AI does the work after reading. One agent across Google Drive, SharePoint, OneDrive, Dropbox, your computer and your NAS. It organizes thousands of files in one prompt, finds duplicates, builds new documents like a closing binder from 20 PDFs, and runs routines on autopilot as new files arrive. It shows the plan first, waits for your OK, and every change can be undone.

records.name: Upsolve Row-Level Security
records.tagline: Data permissions your AI agent can't talk its way past
records.description: Row-level security enforced server side, before any query runs. Set rules from user and org properties, test them as any user, and deploy one agent to thousands of tenants. The agent never sees the rules, so it can't bypass them.

records.name: CLI Manager
records.tagline: Let one AI agent open and drive your other CLI agents
records.description: CLI Manager now has an AI Control API. Claude Code, Codex or any script can open sessions in CLI Manager, send prompts, wait, and read the screen - in terminals you can watch. Sessions an AI is driving turn green in the sidebar, the orchestrator gets a crown, and Disconnect AI takes control back anytime. Local only (REST + MCP on 127.0.0.1), off by default. Plus everything from launch #1: Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI in one sidebar. Free, MIT open source, macOS.

records.name: Google Fitbit Edge
records.tagline: Google’s smartest fitness tracker ever with 7-day battery
records.description: Fitbit Edge is Google’s slim, screen-based fitness tracker for active lifestyles and everyday wear. It has built-in GPS, over 50 workout modes, ECG, skin temperature, and up to seven days of battery per Google. It’s Fitbit’s first repairable tracker, with a replaceable battery. $179.99, pre-order now, on shelves Oct 27. Includes 3 months of Google Health Premium, which is needed for the Health Coach and Health Guardian.

records.name: Agent Craft
records.tagline: 100× your social engagement and leads
records.description: Agent Craft gets your whole team posting from their own social accounts, where posts earn ~7× the engagement of a company page. Each person answers a daily prompt with a 3-minute voice note or video. Craft turns it into native posts for 8 platforms, you approve them in one review queue, and they publish from each person's account. Comments and DMs from likely buyers are qualified and sent to your CRM. $95/month first teammate, $75 each after. 30-day free trial, no card.

records.name: vibesmonitor.com
records.tagline: The ops center for everything you ship
records.description: Vibesmonitor puts traffic, errors, user feedback and cookie consent for every project you ship on one screen, with an inbox of what needs you first. One script per site. Or ask Claude, Cursor or any MCP agent which project needs you today.

records.name: Genchi
records.tagline: Project delivery predictions, from the people doing the work
records.description: Genchi shows engineering leaders a prediction of which projects are heading for a missed deadline and which aren't, from the people doing the work. We've rebuilt it from the ground up. Team members vote with one anonymous click in Slack. Leaders see a combined score for every and trend in one portfolio view, so they know where to step in and which teams to leave alone. Genchi works with Jira and Asana. You can see your live portfolio inside Claude, ChatGPT and Grok. Free for teams of up to 10.

records.name: BoxTrack
records.tagline: Snap your stuff, label boxes, and sell on Marketplace
records.description: BoxTrack is a home inventory app for moving and storage. Snap a photo and AI lists each item and its value. Print QR labels, search any item to find its box, export a customs or insurance list, and, new, fill in Facebook Marketplace listings from Chrome.

records.name: Toby
records.tagline: Realistic mock interviews with an AI hiring manager
records.description: Paste a job description. Toby researches the company, maps every round and interviews you on a Meet, Teams or Zoom-style call. Then you get a scored debrief and a stronger version of each answer, built only from what you said. Real mode runs it straight through; Coach mode gives a note and a retry. No subscription: 50p a minute on a call. First 5 minutes free.

records.name: MausBot
records.tagline: Open source Grok Bot: Free, Local
records.description: Give each bot a job and work with it in a familiar chat interface. MausBot brings your supported AI agents together on your computer, with tools and routines for getting work done. Free and open source under Apache 2.0. Bring your own provider account or API key; provider fees and limits apply.

records.name: EveryGen AI
records.tagline: AI video creation workspace in public preview
records.description: EveryGen AI is a public-preview AI video workspace for planning text-to-video and image-to-video projects. It brings model selection, prompt writing, reference media, output settings and credit estimates into one interface. Real generation and commercial checkout are awaiting activation.

records.name: Muse Wonder
records.tagline: Meta’s most capable models for personal agents
records.description: Muse Wonder is Meta’s new model series for personal and professional agents, with two models: Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full. Active Memory carries your context across conversations, Active Focus keeps working through blockers on hard goals, and it adds domain expertise in law, finance, and health plus stronger coding. Muse Wonder is live on the Meta Model API and Muse Code. Muse Wonder Full is for Muse Code subscribers.

records.name: OpenCode 2.0
records.tagline: The open source AI coding agent
records.description: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent. It’s available as a terminal-based interface, desktop app, or web app.

records.name: Lodge Deck
records.tagline: The modern operating system for exceptional hospitality
records.description: Meet Lodge Deck, a smarter way to run hospitality. Lodge Deck is a modern, AI-powered hotel management platform designed to simplify operations and help hospitality teams deliver exceptional guest experiences. By bringing reservations, room management, front desk operations, housekeeping, guest records, billing, and performance analytics into one connected workspace, Lodge Deck makes everyday hotel management more efficient and organised.

records.name: Etemora Domain Name Generator
records.tagline: Find domain ideas and check availability live
records.description: Type a keyword to get domain name ideas and check availability live with each official registry (RDAP) across 12+ extensions. For taken names, see registrar, age and expiry. Free, no sign-up.

records.name: VexoTalk Weeks Until Calculator
records.tagline: Weeks Until Calculator — Count Down to Any Date
records.description: Ever wondered how many weeks are left until your birthday, a holiday, a vacation, or another special day? VexoTalk Weeks Until Calculator makes it easy to find out! Choose any date and instantly see how many weeks and days remain. Whether you're planning ahead, counting down to an exciting event, or simply curious about a future date, this free tool gives you a quick, simple answer. No complicated steps or signup required. Just pick a date and start your countdown. 🎯

records.name: AI Employee OS
records.tagline: Run your one-person business with 7 AI employees
records.description: Stop using AI like a search box. AI Employee OS turns Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or Copilot into a small team of seven AI employees, each with a job description, a system prompt, a weekly rhythm and KPIs. A 122-page playbook, 71 copy-paste prompts and an Excel/Sheets tracker with an approval queue, 12-week scorecard and ROI calculator. You stay the decision-maker: AI drafts, you approve. Free starter kit available.

records.name: Kitmorrow
records.tagline: 127 useful tools. One membership. Future tools included.
records.description: Stop collecting subscriptions. Kitmorrow brings 127 focused tools for images, PDFs, writing, code, design, and everyday tasks into one account. All Access includes every current tool and future release. Try it free for one hour, no card needed. Standard pricing is €9.99/month; the first 100 members get €4.99/month, locked while their subscription stays active.

records.name: Grants Hub UK
records.tagline: Find UK grants for your charity or business, matched by AI
records.description: Live UK grants for businesses and charities from 1,400+ monitored funders, updated daily. AI ranks the ones your organisation can actually win — plus grant consultants who can help you apply, commission-free. Additionally, an API for developers to match relevant grants to the companies.

records.name: relayted websitepro
records.tagline: Easy Breezy Websiteprocessor paid by use.
records.description: Enter an address, pick a format, done: Markdown, text, metadata, clean HTML or PDF. No account, no subscription, you only pay for what you use.

records.name: NovaForge
records.tagline: Build, deploy & monetize an AI SaaS in 60 seconds
records.description: NovaForge is an autonomous AI SaaS factory. Enter any software idea in natural language, and NovaForge instantly generates a production-ready web app with React UI, live interactive sandboxes, AI API routing, and Stripe subscription billing pre-configured. Stop building boilerplates. Start collecting recurring revenue in minutes.

records.name: Glyphy
records.tagline: Motivating wallpapers, daily quote widgets & a cute keyboard
records.description: Glyphy makes your iPhone look like you. Pick a motivation wallpaper from hundreds of photos and quotes, then tweak everything: font, size, color, shadow, caps and position, with separate looks for Lock and Home Screen. Add the daily quote widget (Home or Lock Screen) and its photo changes with each quote. Plus a custom keyboard with 50+ themes, 80+ fonts and 20+ built-in tools like a translator and calculator. Free to start, no ads, no tracking.

records.name: GotEmail
records.tagline: Native macOS mail app with one-click sign-in codes and AI
records.description: GotEmail is a native Mac mail app for people who live in their inbox. Gmail, Outlook, iCloud and any IMAP account in one fast window. Sign-in codes are one click away, AI drafts and summarizes when you ask. Pay once, use on every Mac.

records.name: ClimateTechReview
records.tagline: Find climate tech investors, companies, events and tools
records.description: ClimateTechReview is a free database and community for climate tech. Browse investors, climate startups and events, follow industry news, and use free tools including a grant finder, investor matcher, funding calculator, carbon credit price estimator, ESG/TCFD checklist and LCOE calculator. Founders find funding and partners. Investors discover companies that are raising.

records.name: Arthneeti
records.tagline: AI that reads worldwide earnings calls so you don't have to
records.description: Screen 1,500+ Indian stocks with AI earnings call insights. Free stock screener, rankings, IPO tracker and financial calculators.

records.name: Privacy Shield
records.tagline: Hide your screen from people nearby, right in Chrome
records.description: Privacy Shield is a Chrome extension that hides your screen from people nearby. Tint, blur or dim any page in one click, use a Spotlight that follows your cursor or eyes, or let the Look-away guard blur everything the moment you look away. Eye tracking runs on a model bundled in the extension, so camera frames never leave your computer. No account, no ads, no analytics. Works in Chrome, Edge and Brave. Free to start.

records.name: Falbor
records.tagline: Your AI partner for business growth.
records.description: Falbor helps businesses grow faster by bringing market insights, competitor research, and AI-powered marketing into one platform. Our goal is to make it easier for businesses to understand their position, discover new opportunities, and make smarter decisions. Built in the open, Falbor is a project we want to grow together with the community.

records.name: Tom Riddle’s Diary
records.tagline: An interactive recreation of Tom Riddle's magical diary
records.description: Step into a mysterious, cinematic web experience inspired by Tom Riddle's diary from Harry Potter. Explore an atmospheric setting with candlelight, a floating quill, and handwriting that magically appears on the pages. An interactive fan-made tribute bringing a little magic to the browser.

records.name: Clipo - Visual Reference Workspace
records.tagline: Collect inspiration from anywhere, all in one place.
records.description: Meet Clipo a visual reference workspace built for designers and creatives. Save images, videos, GIFs, and websites from anywhere(Pinterest, Behance, Dribbble, Instagram, X, and across the web), then organize everything on an infinite canvas. No more scattered screenshots, messy folders, or lost inspiration. With Clipo, you can collect references, explore ideas, and build moodboards in one creative space. Stop collecting. Start creating. Available now for macOS with a 30-day free trial.

records.name: SceneMill
records.tagline: Free offline video editor for Windows, no watermark
records.description: SceneMill is a free video editor for Windows 11. No watermark, no account, works offline. Cut on a multi-track timeline, edit by text, get subtitles transcribed on your own PC in 14 languages, and export up to 4K for YouTube, TikTok and Instagram.

records.name: ORION Game Launcher
records.tagline: Every PC launcher in one library, and the real lowest price
records.description: ORION sits on top of Steam, Epic, GOG, Xbox, Ubisoft, EA and Battle.net: one library, 30+ stores compared for the real lowest price, and per-game settings for your exact PC. Free, no account, no ads, nothing sent without consent.

records.name: Pasteparrot
records.tagline: Translate where you type. Stay in your flow.
records.description: Write in your language and translate into 17 languages without leaving your Mac app. Select text, preview the translation, then replace it. Turn rough ideas into clear AI prompts, too. Supports terminal drafts with optional local Zsh integration.

records.name: Talkume
records.tagline: Your CV and a voice intro, in one link for recruiters
records.description: Talkume puts your CV and a 90-second voice intro behind one link. Recruiters read your CV, hear how you speak, and can see an AI estimate of your language level (CEFR A1–C2) in any language. Free, no account needed.

records.name: ShineGenAI: AI Video Generator
records.tagline: Make AI videos — no subscription, pay per video
records.description: ShineGenAI is a pay-as-you-go AI video generator for your phone. Turn text or a photo into a video using multiple models — Grok, Seedance, Veo, Kling and Wan — and pay only for what you make. No monthly subscription: just open the app, generate, done.

records.name: CalcBright
records.tagline: 160+ free calculators & converters – fast, private, AI-ready
records.description: CalcBright is a collection of 160+ free calculators and converters – mortgage, loan, take-home pay for 166 countries, sales tax & VAT, BMI, GPA, dates, units, live currency and gold prices. Every tool explains its formula with a worked example, updates instantly, and pre-selects your country and currency. No sign-up. Developers and AI assistants can use every calculator through a free API and MCP server.

records.name: UGC Campaign Brief Generator
records.tagline: Turn campaign goals into a brief creators actually follow
records.description: Fill in product, audience, deliverables, do's and don'ts, usage rights and deadline, and get a clean one-page brief to paste into an email or a DM. Pairs with the contract template and the rate calculator so the whole deal is consistent.

records.name: Xuper TV
records.tagline: Xuper TV is an entertainment app designed
records.description: Conseguir Xuper TV APK última versión para Android y disfruta de televisión en vivo, películas, series, deportes y más, con una experiencia de entretenimiento sencilla, fluida y de alta calidad, sin anuncios.

records.name: FDownloader
records.tagline: Download Facebook videos, Reels & 320k MP3 in 1080p HD
records.description: Free, high-speed Facebook video, Reels, Stories and MP3 audio downloader. Extract clean 1080p Full HD streams and true 320kbps audio in your browser without watermarks, software, or account logins.

records.name: Spinture
records.tagline: The real estate OS with an AI that answers every call
records.description: Spinture is one system for running a real estate business: CRM, phone, website, listings, follow-up and contract-to-close tracking, with one record per client. Ava, the built-in AI assistant, answers every call 24/7, calls new leads back in seconds, writes your CRM notes, books showings, and sends you a morning summary of what needs you. Ava always tells callers she's an AI and never dials without consent on file. 14-day trial, then $49/month.

records.name: backi.app
records.tagline: Your WhatsApp photos, sorted into folders by local AI
records.description: Drop an exported WhatsApp chat ZIP and backi.app sorts it into folders: photos by topic (people, memes, food, screenshots…), videos, audio, PDFs. The AI runs in your browser, so your files never touch our servers. Save to Google Drive or as a ZIP

records.name: ShopHelp
records.tagline: AI sales assistant that sells, not just chats
records.description: ShopHelp is an AI sales assistant for Shopify & WooCommerce stores. It answers real product questions from your live inventory, recommends products, recovers abandoned carts, and captures leads — one-time setup fee, no forced monthly SaaS lock-in, and you keep ownership of your own AI/hosting accounts where possible.

records.name: Bump Duo
records.tagline: One pregnancy. Two of you.
records.description: A pregnancy app built for two. Share appointments, tasks, baby names, shopping and the week-by-week guide, so both partners are in it together. For iPhone and Android.

records.name: Don't SPAM Me
records.tagline: Email aliases on your domain that name who leaked them
records.description: Every alias service hides your real address. Don't SPAM Me also tells you which company leaked it. It puts unlimited catch-all aliases on a domain you own. Type any address into a signup form and it starts working with the first email. When an alias gets mail from a sender other than the company you gave it to, you get an alert naming that sender, and the company goes on a Data Sellers list. Disable an alias and it rejects mail with a hard bounce (SMTP 550), so senders stop mailing it.

records.name: TinyDetect
records.tagline: AI text & image detection that runs in your browser
records.description: Paste some text or upload an image, and TinyDetect estimates whether it was made by AI. The models run in your browser, so nothing you check is sent to a server. It's free and you don't need an account. Detectors can get things wrong, so treat a high score as a reason to take a closer look.

records.name: ESG Orbit
records.tagline: Supplier ESG Data, Finally in One Place.
records.description: ESG Orbit helps companies collect, validate and manage ESG and emissions data from suppliers and operations. Bring supplier requests, responses, supporting evidence, validation and data history into one structured workflow — making sustainability data easier to understand, trace and use for reporting.

records.name: Bulin 47 Viral Video AI
records.tagline: Turn your photos into viral Bulin 47 freestyle AI videos
records.description: Bulin47video.ai turns authorized photos into private Bulin 47 / dame hombro freestyle remake videos. Upload your portrait, generate a viral-style AI video, and download an MP4. Built for creators who want the trend without public social posting.

records.name: setupit.ai
records.tagline: setupit.ai
records.description: Setupit.ai is an interactive 3D atlas for starting a company anywhere on Earth. Spin the globe, click a country and get the setup intel in one view: free zones and districts, licence types, entry costs, timelines, tax rates and vetted consultants, then compare any two markets side by side. Once you are formed, plug in AI agents for company secretary, bookkeeping, marketing and sales ops. 22 launch markets today, built for founders who think globally from day one

records.name: IPTV Player
records.tagline: Stream IPTV and VOD content seamlessly with parental control
records.description: Nexus IPTV: Modern Media Player Nexus IPTV is a sleek, modern media player designed to provide a seamless streaming experience for your IPTV and VOD content. Built with performance and usability in mind, our app offers a comprehensive set of tools to organize and enjoy your favorite media directly on your Android device. Key Features: Parental Controls: Built-in safety features allow you to restrict access to mature content categories using a secure PIN, providing a safer environment.

records.name: K-VIBE
records.tagline: Plan Korea around your interests, with Day 1 free
records.description: Plan Korea around your interests and pace. K-VIBE offers an editable Day 1 without sign-up, source-linked places, map-app directions and on-demand transit route lookups. Longer 2–30-day plans depend on verified place coverage. Remaining-day purchases are not open yet; live vehicle arrivals and bookings must be checked with providers. We’re looking for travelers to test the free planner and share route feedback.

records.name: AR10 Handguard

records.description: Explore AR10 handguards for308 and LR308 platforms at AR15Handguard.com. Discover slim-profile M-LOK and free-float options in multiple lengths and finishes. Selected models feature lightweight aluminum construction and include mounting hardware. Check receiver profile, thread specifications, and product compatibility before choosing your handguard. Copy description

records.name: Holiday Weather 24
records.tagline: Where to go when: climate data for 5,000 holiday spots
records.description: Answers "where is it warm in January?" with data instead of listicles. For 5,000 destinations: day and night temperature, sea temperature, sunshine and rain days for every month, averaged 1996-2025 from Copernicus ERA5, NOAA sea temperatures and WMO station normals, plus a 14-day forecast. Month rankings, winter sun, sea temperature and side-by-side comparisons. Free, no sign-up, no ads. English, German, French, Spanish.

records.name: MotoTrade
records.tagline: Preowned Sales Accelerated
records.description: MotoTrade is automotive dealer management software for car, bike, and used vehicle dealers, helping manage inventory, leads, sales, billing, payments, documents, and business performance.

records.name: QR Code Generator
records.tagline: Free QR & barcode maker — animated QR, logos, batch export
records.description: Four code generators in one: classic square QR codes with logos and custom colors, eye-catching circle QR codes with circular border text, artistic animated QR codes blended with GIF backgrounds. Made for real-world use: embed your logo, add center text, match brand colors, and batch export everything in one go. Generation is instant and local, so even large batches are stable and fast.

records.name: Playrivo
records.tagline: Find what to play next — from your own Steam library
records.description: Playrivo reads your public Steam library — playtime, unfinished sagas, never-opened games — and returns three picks for tonight with an honest why. A skip is a verdict too: no ads when the answer is "don't buy".

records.name: Inventory Accounting
records.tagline: Inventory and accounting software for small businesses
records.description: Inventory and accounting software for small business to manage stock, sales, purchases, invoices, expenses and financial reports in one system.

records.name: DeliveryProof
records.tagline: Catch wrong video exports before the final ZIP handoff
records.description: DeliveryProof checks already-approved video exports against final Windows delivery files. It flags missing, extra and SHA-256-changed files, plus selected technical video metadata mismatches. ZIP packaging is blocked unless checks PASS. Free R4 allows five successful ZIPs with no sign-up for direct download. Unlimited use is a separate $39 one-time purchase. The EXE is unsigned; independent Windows 11 and enterprise validation are pending. Not creative, subtitle or broadcast QC.

records.name: The Last Code Bendernk
records.tagline: Claim your dev rank — turn GitHub into a Claude Code skill
records.description: TheLastCodeBender is an open-source developer legacy platform. Claim one permanent rank across 7 disciplines — Frontend, Backend, FullStack, Security, AI, DevOps, QA. One developer per rank, forever. Build your public profile, earn XP from Apprentice to Master, and publish your coding style as an installable Claude Code skill generated from your GitHub history.

records.name: GAFFY
records.tagline: Repairs and certificates for small UK landlords
records.description: GAFFY is software for UK DIY landlords with a handful of properties. Tenants report repairs via a magic link; you track New → Scheduled → Done in one inbox. Certificates and leases live in a per-property vault with expiry warnings for gas safety, EPC and EICR. Software only — you keep your own trades. Free to start.

records.name: Kalm
records.tagline: Open source: Block ads and YouTube scam/NSFW comment bots
records.description: Kalm combines ad blocking based on uBlock Origin Lite, including YouTube ad filters, with a YouTube scam/NSFW comment bot blocker. It checks comment links, public author bios and visible channel promotions before showing comments—even when the text looks ordinary. Add blocked sites or keywords, optionally hide all linked comments, and choose a filtering level per website. Free and open source, with local checks and cached author decisions. Available on Chrome.

records.name: Ingrelo
records.tagline: Snap an ingredient list. Every ingredient, explained.
records.description: Photograph any ingredient list. No barcode, no database lookup - Ingrelo reads the label itself, so it works on the products other apps cannot find. Text recognition runs on your device, so the photo never leaves your phone. Every ingredient is explained in plain language: what it does, what to watch for - acne triggers, irritation, pregnancy cautions - and how it fits the skin profile you set. Free: 3 scans a day.

records.name: Laravilt
records.tagline: Laravel admin panels rendered in Vue or React
records.description: Describe panels, resources, forms and tables in PHP, and Laravilt renders them with Inertia on Vue 3 or React 19. Laravel 13, auth, widgets, AI agents and a remote MCP server for your coding agent. MIT licensed, with a live demo.

records.name: DocuPrune
records.tagline: Turn documents into clean Markdown, locally
records.description: Convert documents and scans to clean Markdown in your browser. Review and edit results, copy or download a file, export a batch, and plan AI context with local token counts. Free to use, no account required.

records.name: Skillon
records.tagline: Reusable skills for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor & Copilot
records.description: Skillon is a marketplace of ready-to-install agent skills — packaged AI workflows (SKILL.md + assets) for coding agents and creators. Browse 391 skills, buy once or go lifetime, and install in one step from your browser or CLI.

records.name: StudyBuddyAI
records.tagline: Easy to use app for homework help and studying
records.description: Built by a student, for students. StudyBuddyAI is an AI homework assistant that cuts through the confusion to deliver instant, step-by-step explanations, not just copy-paste answers.

records.tagline: Your Trusted Scaffolding Company in Stoke on Trent
records.description: Best scaffolding company in Stoke on Trent, we deliver safe access for domestic, commercial and industrial work fully insured, safety-focused and built around your schedule.

records.description: SMTP250, a product of ADHOCON GmbH, forwards email and returns a signed PDF documenting recipient server acceptance. €1 incl. VAT: reserve first, capture after SMTP 250 OK. Free DEMO without forwarding. No app, account or subscription. Not proof of reading or inbox placement. Operator details: smtp250.org/legal.html

records.name: TVBID
records.tagline: Your ad. The whole screen. On repeat. Preview now.
records.description: TVBID is onlineeeeee !!! Explore a full-screen video advertising preview built with React and TypeScript. Paid spots are coming soon: guest checkout, video review and the payment/fiscal flow are not active yet. The planned first slot is €5; each next video adds €5 and replaces the previous one. AI-generated illustrative scenes, not customer or revenue claims.

records.name: Zipperhide
records.tagline: Hide and encrypt private files in a local Windows vault
records.description: Zipperhide is a local encrypted vault for Windows. Drag a file in and it disappears from its folder: encrypted with AES-256-GCM (filenames included) and unlocked only by your key, which is never stored. No cloud, no account, no internet. Open files with one click without restoring them, organize them in folders, browse encrypted thumbnails, and lock instantly to wipe keys from memory. The original is only removed after the encrypted copy is verified. ~2.5 MB installer.

records.name: MindiMap
records.tagline: AI mind maps, flowcharts and tasks in your browser
records.description: MindiMap is an AI-powered mind map, flowchart and task maker that runs in your browser. Describe an idea in one sentence and it drafts a full visual map in seconds. Two sharing modes: read-only links and QR codes for anyone to view, or editable links for a colleague to edit alongside you. Six themes, eleven templates, exports to PNG, PDF, SVG or JSON. Free tier, no install, works offline, available in 9 languages with full RTL support.

records.name: Audit: Code Attribution Tracker
records.tagline: Know who — or which AI — wrote every line in your codebase
records.description: Hello Product Hunt community! 👋 We built Audit because modern software development is fundamentally changing. Today, engineering teams aren't just writing code by hand—they are collaborating with GitHub Copilot, Cursor Agent, Claude Code, and ChatGPT. Yet our version control tools still treat every line of code as if a human typed it character-by-character.

records.name: CueCardConverter
records.tagline: Turn any speech or script into printable cue cards
records.description: CueCardConverter turns a speech, host script or PowerPoint speaker notes into printable cue cards. Paste text or upload Word, PDF, PowerPoint, ODT, TXT or Markdown. AI splits the text at natural pauses, never mid-sentence, and highlights names, numbers, times and stage cues. Edit any card, then print 3x5, 4x6, A5 or A6 cards several per sheet with cut lines, or export PDF, PPTX or DOCX. Free, no sign-up, and editing and printing keep working offline.

records.name: Quinta SI
records.tagline: Say what your business needs. Quinta SI builds and runs it.
records.description: Write one sentence — "track repair orders, technicians and spare parts" — and in about a minute you have a working system: tables, the forms your team fills in, a portal for your clients, reports. Want it different? Say so. No builder to learn, nothing to configure by hand. Bring your spreadsheet and it becomes the system around your rows. Free to start, no card. SI stands for Super Intelligence, our bet on what comes after AI: not a helper beside your software, the thing that builds it.

records.name: Botview.app
records.tagline: See how AI search sees your business
records.description: BotView shows how AI search sees your site. Free scans check which of 18 AI crawlers your robots.txt allows and compare what people and crawlers see. Pro ($9/mo) adds OpenAI web-search answer checks: are you mentioned, and which sources get cited.

records.name: BatchMaster ERP for Bakeries
records.tagline: Run bakery production with better planning and control
records.description: BatchMaster ERP helps UK bakery manufacturers manage recipes, ingredient costs, production planning, inventory and batch traceability in one connected system. From artisan and industrial bakeries to growing bakery businesses, it supports better production visibility, consistent product quality and more informed decisions as demand, ingredient prices and product ranges change.

records.name: Puzzle Me
records.tagline: Relax, play & create beautiful jigsaw puzzles every day
records.description: 🧩 Puzzle Me — your pocket-sized jigsaw studio. ✨ Daily curated puzzles, custom photo puzzles (turn any photo into a jigsaw), 4 difficulty levels (24 to 1000+ pieces), auto-saved progress, and full offline play. Designed for calm, focus, and the simple joy of clicking pieces into place — no ads mid-game, no pay-to-win tricks. 👉 play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.puzzleme.puzzle_me

records.name: Trendjectory
records.tagline: Market intelligence built for marketing and sales decisions
records.description: AI makes finding information easy. It hasn't made knowing what to trust, what matters and what to do about it any easier. Trendjectory is a market intelligence platform built by life-long marketers for marketing and sales pros who use secondary research. Structured prompts built around decision types. Every cited link verified to open a real article matching the claim. The same methodology every run, so reports compare quarter to quarter. Try it on a business challenge and check the findings.

records.name: Digital Capital Ltd
records.tagline: Intelligence Layer!!
records.description: Digital Capital Ltd est une plateforme axée sur la technologie qui associe l’intelligence artificielle à des outils d’analyse des marchés financiers afin d’aider les utilisateurs à suivre les tendances et à explorer l’évolution des marchés mondiaux. La plateforme se concentre sur l’analyse des données de marché, le suivi des mouvements de prix et l’identification de tendances potentielles pour faciliter la compréhension des conditions changeantes du marché.

records.name: FirstHabbit
records.tagline: To-dos and daily habits, finally in one calm app
records.description: Most people run two apps: a to-do list and a habit tracker. One always gets abandoned. FirstHabbit puts both in one calm Today view. Routines are just to-dos that repeat, with streaks and a week-at-a-glance strip. Type "Walk every day 7am" or "Call mom tomorrow 6pm #family" and it's scheduled. Inbox, Upcoming, Someday, Areas and Projects keep everything else in place. Reminders let you mark done or snooze from the notification. Free to use. Premium for unlimited projects.

records.name: SVGMaker 2.0
records.tagline: AI Design Agent for On brand, editable SVGs vector assets
records.description: SVGMaker 2.0 is an agentic AI design platform that learns your brand’s visual style once, enabling you to generate, edit, convert, and scale consistent, editable SVGs and vector assets. From logo, icon, and illustration packs to UI assets, print-on-demand graphics, Cricut and laser-cutting designs, fantasy characters, and more, it brings everything together in one seamless workflow, with support for APIs, MCP, and integrations with Figma and Framer.

records.name: CodeSplitterDex
records.tagline: Turn one HTML file into clean HTML, CSS & JS
records.description: CodeSplitterDex splits one HTML file into separate HTML, CSS and JS files and gives you a ready ZIP. Paste or import code, preview it live. Free, private, no signup.

records.name: MyTaxCalculators
records.tagline: Free, accurate tax calculators for multiple countries
records.description: MyTaxCalculators offers free, accurate tax calculators for multiple countries. It covers US paychecks across all 50 states, cross-border contractor taxes for 33+ corridors, tax relocation comparisons and VAT/GST for 16 economies. Built for employees, freelancers, expats and digital nomads. Also offers embeddable calculator suites for your website.

records.name: Event Perpetual
records.tagline: Paper-trade sports and real-world event markets
records.description: Explore sports and real-world event markets in a working paper-trading demo. Browse events, follow price charts, and open and close positions using simulated money. Event Perpetual brings a familiar trading interface to event markets, with multiple chart styles. This early demo offers no real-money trading; we’re looking for feedback on clarity, usability, and the trading flow.

records.name: PinPointed
records.tagline: From scattered to started: a visual centering ritual
records.description: PinPointed is a quiet visual ritual for the moment before your next task. Glowing points converge on one center while you watch, then you begin. Fully offline, no account, no data collected. Free to use; a one-time $2.99 unlock adds Wisp mode and more.

records.name: Innovacar
records.tagline: Run your car rental agency in French, English & Arabic
records.description: Innovacar is an all-in-one platform for car rental agencies in Morocco. Manage your fleet, bookings and clients, generate contracts with remote e-signature, track payments and vehicles with GPS, and scan registration cards to auto-fill vehicle data. Available in French, English and Arabic (RTL), with a 30-day free trial.

records.name: Letras Bonitas App
records.tagline: 100+ fancy text styles for Instagram, TikTok & WhatsApp
records.description: Letras Bonitas App is a free online tool that turns your normal text into 100+ stylish Unicode fonts: aesthetic, gothic, bold, cursive, Korean style and more. Type your name, pick a style, copy and paste it into your Instagram bio, TikTok username, WhatsApp status or Free Fire nickname. No signup, no app to install, works right in your mobile browser.

records.name: Domelu API
records.tagline: Turn any domain into rich company metadata & verified emails
records.description: Turn any website domain into rich corporate intelligence, verified employee emails, and company metadata wi“Stop wasting time scraping or paying for overpriced B2B databases. Give our API a domain, and instantly get structured corporate intelligence, verified employee emails, and complete metadata in a single JSON response. Perfect for CRM enrichment, lead generation, and vetting signups.”th a single API call

records.name: Mental — Mood Tracker & Journal
records.tagline: A mood journal with memory for the moments behind it.
records.description: Mental is a private mood tracker and visual journal for iPhone. A 7×7 feeling grid makes check-ins quick; add context by typing or voice, then revisit your journal as moments gather into a story. New in 2.2, Memory connects the people, situations, and themes you choose to record. In Mental Pro, trace a memory to its check-in, correct it, or ask Mental to forget it. Optional features ask before they process relevant journal context.

records.name: TabSill
records.tagline: Save & restore your tabs. On your machine, not a server.
records.description: TabSill saves any Chrome window as a named session and brings it back exactly as it was: tab groups, colours, pinned tabs. Every 5 minutes it takes a quiet snapshot, so a crash or an update never costs you a day of research. No account, no cloud, no tracking: everything stays in your browser, exportable any time. Import your collections from other tab managers in two clicks. Free with no limits. Optional Pro, paid once (launch price €11.40): 30-day snapshot history and search across everything.

records.name: ToolKit
records.tagline: 62+ free tools that run in your browser — nothing uploaded
records.description: ToolKit is a collection of 62+ free online tools that run entirely in your browser. File converters, scientific calculator, speech-to-text with AI, resume builder, invoice generator, image tools and more. No signup, no watermarks, no character limits — and your files never leave your device, because everything runs locally. Built for students, freelancers, engineers and anyone tired of "free" tools that stop being free the moment you press download. New tools added regularly.

records.name: XBio
records.tagline: The link-in-bio page that doesn't look like a template
records.description: Most link-in-bio pages look identical because they're all the same template. XBio gives you 13 WebGL shader backgrounds (With more to come), a deep visual editor, XP and levels that reward traffic, and a marketplace where creators can sell themes. Free to start, $5/mo for Pro.

records.name: kiwi material mate
records.tagline: "Smart estimates. Kiwi specs. Job done."
records.description: Quick quantity and pricing estimates for NZ builders, tradies, homeowners and DIYers. Try every material calculator. "Kiwi Material Mate takes the headache out of site ordering. Instead of guessing coverage or burning time on complex pitch math, you get exact, NZ-code-compliant material lists right from your phone—even when you're completely offline. Measure once, order right, and get back to building."

records.name: CargoSum
records.tagline: Free freight calculators with a 3D container load planner
records.description: CargoSum is a set of free freight calculators that run in your browser: no sign-up, no quote form, nothing sent to a server. The core is a 3D container load planner: enter mixed cartons and crates, and it packs them into a 20ft, 40ft, 40HC, 45HC or custom container, shows weight balance and center of gravity, and gives you a shareable link. Also: CBM, chargeable weight, pallet loading, NMFC freight class, LTL linear feet, fuel surcharge and demurrage. In English, German, Japanese and Korean.

records.name: ActivePause PRO
records.tagline: Smart Windows break timer with guided workspace exercises
records.description: I spent 10+ hours a day coding and my back was completely destroyed. So I built this native Windows app to force myself to take active breaks and stretch. ActivePause PRO softly interrupts your screen and guides you through specific workplace exercises (like calves, shoulders, and posture correction). No more back pain or eye strain while working! Special launch price of $10 for lifetime access.

records.name: waterhardness
records.tagline: Free hyper-local UK water hardness checker & guides
records.description: Waterhardness UK is an independent platform providing accurate, hyper-local water hardness metrics across UK postcodes. Easily check PPM, Clark degrees, and find calibration guides for home appliances like dishwashers, coffee makers, and washing machines.

records.name: GuanPalm
records.tagline: AI palm readings and shareable visual cards
records.description: Turn a palm photograph into an AI-assisted palm reading and a magazine-style card. The complete basic reading is free; MASTER costs $1 once for a watermark-free card and a separate 30-day calendar. Supports Traditional Chinese, Japanese and English. For entertainment and personal reflection, not prediction or professional advice.

records.name: Revmrr
records.tagline: Discover Startups. Explore Revenue. Find Opportunities.
records.description: Revmrr is a startup intelligence platform: explore real startups, revenue signals, growth metrics, market intelligence and AI-powered buildability insights — then find what to build next.

records.name: CPM.calc
records.tagline: Free CPM calculator for ad cost, reach, and budget planning
records.description: CPM.calc is a free advertising calculator that turns ad spend and impressions into cost per thousand impressions. Calculate CPM, work backwards from a target budget or reach goal, compare planning scenarios, and understand the trade-offs between CPM, CPC, CPA, reach, and frequency. No account is required for the basic calculator.

records.name: AnyEdit
records.tagline: Open pro files free in your browser
records.description: Open PSD, XLSX, DXF, WAV, PDF, DOCX and RAW photos in free browser editors. Twelve open-source editors from ArtCraft, found by file format. No install, no sign-up, and your files stay on your device.

records.name: Max Commander
records.tagline: Classic commander soul. Modern Windows file management.
records.description: Max Commander brings the classic dual-pane file manager to modern Windows. Preview code, documents and media, browse archives as folders, play music, share folders on your LAN, and extend your panels with plugins—or build your own using our spec and AI authoring skill. Pro adds disk-space analysis, duplicate finding, profiles, tags and dedicated Git views. Free works without registration; Pro is a one-time purchase with lifetime updates.

records.name: OKURU Order SMS
records.tagline: OKURU Order SMS, Shopify Apps
records.description: OKURU Order SMS helps Shopify merchants automate order notifications and customer messaging through SMS. Send order confirmations, shipping and delivery updates, refund alerts, and abandoned checkout reminders. Customize SMS templates, connect supported gateways, and run bulk messaging campaigns to keep customers informed and engaged. Simplify store communication and improve the shopping experience with OKURU Order SMS by MageComp.

records.name: Tattoo Doodle
records.tagline: Free AI tattoo tools: generator, 33 fonts & try-on
records.description: Free AI-powered tattoo tools - AI tattoo generator, tattoo font generator with 33 lettering styles previewed on skin tones, tattoo ideas gallery, and try-on simulator. No sign-up required.

records.name: Proof Alarm: Wake Up Missions
records.tagline: Prove you're awake
records.description: No account, and photos never leave your phone. Proof Alarm is an iPhone alarm you can't tap away: photograph an object, solve math, escape a maze, play Flappy Bell and more. Nine missions, all checked on your device.

records.name: Leakly
records.tagline: Find revenue leaks before they cost you millions.
records.description: Leakly analyzes your website to uncover conversion leaks that cost you signups, leads, and revenue. It identifies friction across content, UX, UI, funnels, trust, and performance, then prioritizes the issues that matter most and shows you what to fix first.

records.name: ZySurveys
records.tagline: Earn real US dollars for surveys, games and offers
records.description: ZySurveys pays real US dollars, not points, for paid surveys, games and offers. Every survey shows its reward and time before you start. Cash out from $10 (then $5) to Recipient's Choice gift cards, prepaid Visa or Mastercard, or Wise in every supported country, plus US brand gift cards and bank transfer. Bonus codes, a daily leaderboard and referrals help you earn more.

records.name: Inkling
records.tagline: Inkling. From questions to action.
records.description: Inkling is an AI answer engine that puts the source beside every sentence. Ask in Quick, Pro, or Research depth, get a second opinion, set watches that keep searching, translate whole files, and save it all to notes and to-dos that keep their citations.

records.name: AEO Audit Tool
records.tagline: Free 6-check AI search readiness audit, no signup
records.description: Free tool that checks whether ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity can crawl, read and attribute your website. Six checks, a scored report, and a fix-first PDF you can download. No signup needed.

records.name: Tengri Chat
records.tagline: Business-trained website chat and enquiry capture
records.description: Tengri Chat answers website visitors using your business knowledge, supports multilingual conversations and captures enquiries for follow-up. Review chats, leads and human follow-up flags in one workspace. Optional WhatsApp alerts require a paid plan and verified, consenting number. Made by Tengri Global Group.

records.name: RenderQue
records.tagline: Create your proxies in the cloud. Not on your machine.
records.description: RenderQue renders Premiere-ready video proxies in the cloud instead of on your machine. Point it at Google Drive footage and finished proxies land back in your Drive.

records.name: Quotum
records.tagline: What's left on each AI coding account, in your menu bar
records.description: Quotum is a Mac menu bar app that shows what's left on your AI coding accounts — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and 21 more — and how old each figure is. Alerts warn you when your pace will drain an account before it resets. For the tools you track, it reuses the sign-in they already keep on your Mac; it never rewrites another tool's credentials or poses as an official client. Public source of what it reads and sends: github.com/mashgundash/quotum-transparence. €4.99 once, macOS 26+.

records.name: Operator Grid
records.tagline: Run your cleaning business from one connected spreadsheet
records.description: Operator Grid is a connected spreadsheet system for cleaning business owners, built for Excel and Google Sheets. Track leads and follow-ups, build quotes, plan jobs and recurring clients, and see revenue, expenses and profit in one place, with 18 AI workflows for everyday tasks. No blank-spreadsheet setup and no subscription: $149 one-time, and the files are yours.

records.name: Hawser
records.tagline: AI that notices when you drift and nudges you back on task
records.description: A blocker can't tell a 10 hour work day from a 10 hour binge. Hawser can. It's an AI accountability app for Windows. Write today's tasks, or connect your own Claude and it plans your week, with every plan waiting for your yes. Then Hawser keeps you on the task in front of you: it sees what you're actually doing and nudges you back when you drift. It asks instead of blocking, unless you want blocks. Tasks and history live on your PC, and screenshots are never stored. 14 days free, no card.

records.name: Entovist
records.tagline: Workforce scheduling for multi-location teams
records.description: Entovist is shift planning for multi-location teams. Build schedules from skills and availability, catch conflicts before go-live, and let employees swap shifts and manage absences in one portal — plus time tracking for planned vs worked hours.

records.name: APEXVYRA
records.tagline: Premium AI SaaS template in HTML, CSS & Vanilla JS
records.description: Most AI/SaaS templates stop at the landing page. APEXVYRA gives you a full marketing site plus a working dashboard shell. • 24+ pages & screens • 7-page dashboard: Overview, AI Chat, Analytics, Projects, Team, Settings, Billing • Dark & light mode, fully responsive • Custom SVG data visualizations • 24-section documentation • Pure HTML, CSS & Vanilla JS, no build step

records.name: Trippi Cue
records.tagline: Interview copilot that translates the interviewer live
records.description: Trippi Cue is a Chrome extension for job interviews on Google Meet, Zoom and Teams in the browser. It hears the question addressed to you, shows a short suggested answer while the interviewer is still waiting, and puts the interviewer's words in your own language, out of 68. No bot joins the call and nothing is recorded. It does not work in the Zoom or Teams desktop apps or on a phone, and it does not try to hide from anyone.

records.name: SmartWardrobe
records.tagline: Find clothes across retailers from a photo or keyword
records.description: SmartWardrobe is a free clothing search engine. Search across hundreds of retailers at once or upload any outfit photo to find exact matches and affordable alternatives. Unbiased results sorted by price with zero markups or sponsored ranking.

records.name: SmartRentier
records.tagline: Modern, automated property management software for owners.
records.description: SmartRentier is a modern SaaS platform designed for landlords and property managers who want to eliminate tedious spreadsheets. Effortlessly track rental properties, tenants, contracts, payments, and utility billings in one clean dashboard. Generate PDF documents, automate notifications, and keep your rental business organized and profitable. Start for free — no credit card required!

records.name: DeskUtils
records.tagline: A native Mac toolbox for screenshots, clipboard, OCR & more.
records.description: DeskUtils brings your everyday Mac utilities into one native app. 🚀 📋 Clipboard Manager — Search, pin, and reuse copied items. 📸 Screenshot & Annotation — Capture, blur, and highlight. 🔎 OCR — Extract text with Apple Vision. 🎨 Color Picker — Pick colors from your screen. ⚡ QuickRing — Launch commands right from your cursor. Built by a solo developer for a simpler, more seamless Mac workflow. I'd love your feedback! What utility would you add next?

records.name: Chrome Relay
records.tagline: AI agents use your Chrome logins in background tabs
records.description: Give Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or Paseo access to your everyday Chrome, signed in as you, in background tabs. Chrome Relay connects a Chrome extension and small macOS service to the open-source agent-browser CLI. Free and MIT licensed.

records.name: Description Modifier
records.tagline: Find and replace inside every YouTube description
records.description: YouTube Studio only adds or removes text at the start or end of a description. Description Modifier finds and replaces any text anywhere in your descriptions — across all your videos at once, with a safety preview.

records.name: Split the Drive
records.tagline: Meet halfway by drive time, not by map distance
records.description: Most halfway tools drop a pin at the map midpoint. But roads aren't straight or equally fast, so one person ends up driving much longer. Split the Drive finds the meeting point where the driving time is actually fair: the shortest possible longest drive, or drives as equal as possible. Add two or more people, mark anyone who should drive less, then browse real parks, coffee shops, restaurants and cinemas near the spot. Free, no sign-up, and every result is a shareable link.

records.name: Geo-Smart-Links
records.tagline: One link that sends every visitor to their local store
records.description: Geo-Smart-Links started as a geo-redirect tool — it's now a full smart-link platform. One short link routes every visitor by country, device and OS: an Amazon affiliate's single link resolves to amazon.co.uk, amazon.de and so on, each with the right tag. New since launch #1: editable dynamic QR codes, link-in-bio with per-country buttons, A/B testing, open-in-app deep-linking, branded gsl.li links, vanity codes, and analytics by country & device. Free to start, flat plans from $9/mo.

records.name: Draftiva
records.tagline: Tailor your CV to any job, without made-up experience
records.description: Draftiva is an AI CV builder that tailors your CV to a specific job description. It asks only the questions needed to fill gaps, then generates a polished CV you can export as a PDF, and it never invents experience or skills. Try one free CV tailored to a job every day, no card needed: https://draftiva.app/

records.name: Breakgain
records.tagline: Make your annual leave go further
records.description: Breakgain is a free annual leave optimiser that helps you make the most of your time off. Enter your location, leave allowance and preferences, then compare three strategies: Best Value, Longest Escape and Balanced Year. Using verified public holiday data, Breakgain finds the best dates to request so you can plan longer, smarter breaks.

records.name: Log Spend Auditor
records.tagline: Find costly Splunk ingest without sending data anywhere
records.description: Log Spend Auditor is a local-first CLI for understanding where Splunk ingest volume is going and which datasets may deserve review. Run a free Community Quickscan using read-only Splunk metadata or CSV exports. Pro adds full evidence, explanations, recommendations, risk context, and HTML/Markdown reports. Your raw Splunk events stay in your environment.

records.name: Viola UI
records.tagline: The fintech Figma UI kit where every number agrees
records.description: Most UI kits fake their numbers screen by screen, so they quietly stop matching. Viola UI is a Figma kit for fintech and AI products built on one portfolio: the dashboard, holdings table, fund page and cash account all reconcile, in light and dark. 45 desktop screens, 440 component variants, 42 colour tokens. Includes KYC onboarding, trading, EUR/USD cash and an AI copilot. Free version available. Full kit $49, team licence $179.

records.name: Enkily
records.tagline: You talk. It sorts. You never forget.
records.description: Say one rambling thought. Enkily splits out the tasks, reminders and events, sends each to the app you already use (Reminders, Calendar, Todoist), and keeps the rest searchable, so you can ask later what you said. Every answer shows where it came from. iPhone only for now; free to try, Pro is $7.99/month or $69/year with a 7-day trial.

records.name: Encyclopedia 2000
records.tagline: The CD-ROM encyclopedia, reborn with today's Wikipedia.
records.description: A free desktop encyclopedia for Windows, inspired by the CD-ROM reference software of the early 2000s and powered by today's Wikipedia. Free, with no ads, accounts, or tracking in the app.

records.name: HiTest
records.tagline: AI QA agent that tests your app like real users
records.description: Meet HiTest, your AI QA agent. Spend less time on repetitive testing. Let AI explore your product and create test cases, record a flow in Live View, upload a recording, or import cases from Excel. Write tests in natural language—no code required. Run them in a real browser and investigate failures with screenshots, recordings, and failed-step details. Run on demand, schedule daily checks, or trigger tests through GitHub Actions and GitLab CI. Send results to Slack.

records.name: CricArcade
records.tagline: Free cricket strategy games built on 8700+ real matches
records.description: CricArcade is a free, browser-based cricket gaming platform built on over 8,700 real Test, ODI and IPL matches, with 10,000+ users in its first two months. Play Tests, ODIs and T20s, run an IPL dynasty from any season since 2008 with real auctions, take a nation through a World Cup cycle, or challenge a friend head to head. Player ratings come from what they actually did on the field, so matches play out like real cricket. Runs in your browser, no download.

records.name: BasicOps
records.tagline: The workplace where humans and AI agents work as one team.
records.description: BasicOps is a workplace for projects, tasks, communication, and files, where AI agents get a seat, a role, and permissions and work alongside your team. Bring agents from any builder, on any model, with a person in control. Working with agents should be as easy and familiar as working with your human team members. You can chat like Slack, manage tasks and projects like Asana, monitor progress and get reports all in one place.

records.name: HellowMe
records.tagline: Your DMs, by invitation only.
records.description: Your link in bio can do more than show people your links. Put HellowMe in your link in bio. People can still find all your links, but when they want to reach you, they choose the reason — collaboration, brand deal, investment, whatever — and send a request. They also verify their email before sending, so you get fewer spam and fake requests.

records.name: Rewatch
records.tagline: Never rewatch a YouTube video again
records.description: I got tired of rewatching the same YouTube videos just to find the useful part. Rewatch turns any YouTube link into AI notes: one-line TL;DW, key points, action items, and chapters that jump to the exact moment. It becomes your private, searchable knowledge library. Free forever for up to 100 videos (no card needed). Pro is $3.99/mo or $29.99/yr for unlimited videos + chat, mind maps, graph view, playlist import, and more. Try it free → rewatch.club

records.name: RAIKID
records.tagline: Parent-approved AI for safer conversations with kids
records.description: RaiKid gives parents control over how their kids interact with AI. Set family rules, customize an age-adaptive AI companion, and receive insights about potentially concerning content — while encouraging learning and creativity.

records.name: Kosh
records.tagline: Help your family find insurance and take the next step
records.description: Kosh keeps your insurance details, document locations and claim contacts together. Share access with family so they can find your policies, ask questions and get AI guidance on what to do next.

records.name: Blobz
records.tagline: Playful, deterministic avatars for every user.
records.description: Blobz generates playful, deterministic SVG avatars from any username, email, or ID. With 4.9 billion+ possible combinations, every user gets a unique, consistent identity without image uploads or storage costs. Integrate Blobz using the free, unlimited React package, ready-to-use shadcn components, or a hosted API with paid plans for high-volume usage. Unique avatars, zero storage, effortless integration.

records.name: Ruflo Console
records.tagline: Mission control for your AI agents inside Claude Code
records.description: Mission control for AI work inside Claude Code. Plan missions, follow workflows and agent activity, inspect logs and results, and track models, tokens and cost. Bring approvals, questions and failures into one view. Let Claude operate the console within permissions you choose, then take back control at any time. Explore memory, security, project decisions and plugins from the same cockpit. Open source, with optional animated themes.

records.name: GiftPicker
records.tagline: Gift ideas for the indecisive
records.description: GiftPicker started as a side project in 2021, when it won #3 Product of Day. Five years later, people are still using and loving it, so we rebuilt it from the ground up! Better matching algorithms, 4x the number of hand-picked gift ideas, and a full redesign. Answer five questions about the person and get a shortlist of genuinely good, hand-picked gifts.

records.name: Lokutor
records.tagline: Voice AI on speech foundation models we train ourselves
records.description: Lokutor is a speech AI company in Madrid. We design and train our own small speech foundation models: Versa (text to speech in 9 languages, incl. Catalan, Galician and Basque), Turno (turn-taking: knows when the caller is done and lets them interrupt) and Psst (noise suppression), with Conv 2.0 (speech recognition) in development. Small models make it fast and affordable: agents answer in about 0.6 s (596 ms median) for about 5¢ a minute, LLM included. Live demo on lokutor.com, no sign-up.

records.name: Benson - Block Discount Extensions
records.tagline: Block discount extensions from stealing your margin.
records.description: Benson shows online stores which coupon extensions and AI shopping agents are in their sessions and what they cost. Stores can then hide, cap or replace them, with a holdout behind every change. Detection and agent analytics are free on every plan. New stores get 14 days of the full product with no card needed.

records.name: Agent Desk + Session Intelligence
records.tagline: Find past AI coding sessions and learn what went wrong
records.description: Find past AI coding work and learn what to change next. Agent Desk brings sessions from Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, Kiro and Antigravity into one local macOS app, with rules, skills and hooks in a separate harness view. Session Intelligence analyzes extracted transcripts for missing context, repeated corrections, outcomes and wasted effort. Two separate MIT-licensed tools. Build Agent Desk from source; run analysis with your own LLM.

records.name: TrailMind
records.tagline: AI running coach that adapts after every run
records.description: TrailMind is a personal running coach powered by AI. Tell it about an upcoming race and it builds a training plan up to race day — then adjusts it week by week based on how your runs actually go. After every run, the coach analyzes pace, consistency, and elevation, and explains what it means. Full GPS tracking, suggested loop routes, and a no-ads social feed to share runs with friends. Free to start. TrailMind+ unlocks unlimited AI plans and analysis. Built solo, iOS only for now.

records.name: iStore Pro
records.tagline: #webdev #javascript #ecommerce #template  #buildinpublic
records.description: A fully functional iPhone e-commerce store built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Features: Product catalog, Shopping cart, Checkout flow, Supabase integrat...

records.name: Image Generator
records.tagline: High-Performance AI Art, Dual-Engine Arena & Graphic Utility
records.description: Morphs Image Generator Suite is a lightweight, zero-bloat AI creation engineered for creators, designers, and power users. Available as an Android application and a Windows Desktop GUI, the suite pairs instant, watermark-free neural diffusion generation with professional editing tools, intelligent failover pipelines, and an accessible, high-contrast user interface.

records.name: MONEA
records.tagline: Know where your money goes and what you have left.
records.description: MONEA is a simple personal finance dashboard that brings your income, expenses, subscriptions and savings together in one place. Track spending, monitor savings goals and understand what you have left to spend. One-time payment of £19.99, with no subscription.

records.name: Drive Browser
records.tagline: Search your unplugged drives, discs and tapes
records.description: Drive Browser catalogs your external drives, USB sticks, discs and LTO tapes so you can search them while they sit unplugged on the shelf. New in 2.2: keep one shared catalog on a NAS that every machine on the network reads, drive cards for 32 media types with your own drive photos, drive bins, and a warning when a drive starts failing during a scan. Windows and Mac. 14-day free trial, then $39.99 one-time for 2 computers.

records.name: subnera
records.tagline: Your Train at Home fleet, at a glance
records.description: The official Train at Home app often looks frozen while your miner is queued. subnera reads its log and shows the real queue position, ETA and training stats in the menu bar, with one dashboard for all your Macs.

records.name: PropMap Cloud
records.tagline: Mapas interactivos y gestión de ventas inmobiliarias
records.description: PropMap Cloud es una potente plataforma SaaS y PropTech diseñada para desarrolladores inmobiliarios y equipos de ventas. Transforma planos estáticos en mapas interactivos en tiempo real con selección de lotes, medidas exactas y estados en vivo (Libre, Vendido, Reservado). Incluye un portal para asesores de campo y un panel de control gerencial con auditoría y reportes PDF instantáneos.

records.name: IRPForge
records.tagline: Audit-ready incident response plans for small organizations
records.description: Answer a guided set of questions about your organization, and IRPForge builds a branded, audit-ready incident response plan from your answers. You get three documents: a Master Incident Response Plan, an Incident Report Form, and a one-page Emergency Contact sheet. No security expertise needed. Starter is $199, one time. Built on publicly available CIS Controls v8 and NIST Cybersecurity Framework standards. Not certified, endorsed, or affiliated with NIST, CIS, or any government agency.

records.name: Cartsella Studio
records.tagline: One Shopify app for the three jobs every stores struggles
records.description: The Shopify app to clone your store into staging, add tables and size charts to metafields, and share links that fill the cart with a discount.

records.name: SnapToSell. Photo to woocommerce product
records.tagline: Turn any photo into a complete WooCommerce listing with AI
records.description: SnapToSell turns one product photo into a complete WooCommerce listing — title, description, price, and category, written by AI, published straight from your phone. Stop wasting hours writing product descriptions. Just snap, review, and sync directly to your online store in seconds. Built for store owners and resellers who want to scale faster.

records.name: Personal Fall Protection Equipment
records.tagline: A Safety Solution for Working at Height
records.description: Working at height has never been an easy task, as the risk of falls remains a constant concern. Personal fall protection equipment is an essential safety solution that helps reduce the risk of accidents and provides workers with greater peace of mind. In this article, join Thien Bang to learn more about this equipment and its role in workplace safety.

records.name: Form4Beacon
records.tagline: Research SEC Form 4 insider activity with context
records.description: Form4Beacon turns public SEC Form 4 filings into a searchable, source-linked research workflow. Filter reported insider transactions, browse activity by date, understand transaction codes, and verify each record against the original SEC filing.

records.name: DeskGate
records.tagline: Self-Hosted Employee Monitoring
records.description: DeskGate brings employee activity reporting and endpoint management onto your own infrastructure. Review application and website usage, manage device policies, and maintain hardware and software inventory from one administrative workspace. It is designed for teams that want self-hosted deployment and control over how activity data is stored and reviewed.

records.name: Pet Travel Planner
records.tagline: Pet travel rules, hotel search and trip details in one app
records.description: Taking your dog or cat on a trip? Bring the planning into one place. Browse airline pet policies, check country entry requirements, search hotels with map results, and keep your pet’s profile and key travel details together. Free for iPhone and iPad. Always confirm current requirements with the airline, hotel or official government source before travelling.

records.name: Formaty
records.tagline: One browser workspace for JSON, CSV, cURL, Diffs and utils
records.description: Format, query, diff and convert JSON, XML, YAML, TOML and CSV. Compare lists of thousands of IDs and export as SQL. Turn cURL into code. Generate types and schemas. Runs in your browser, no signup, free and open source.

records.name: CollectivWork
records.tagline: Built for businesses that aim higher
records.description: CollectivWork brings attendance, leave, payroll, recruitment and performance into one HRMS platform. Its mobile-first access, configurable workflows and AI-powered features help teams manage people and work across locations. Businesses can choose relevant modules, manage multiple companies and use cloud or on-premises deployment, with multi-language capabilities, integrations and 24/7 support.

records.name: Omnimount
records.tagline: Read & write ext4 and NTFS drives on your Mac
records.description: Omnimount mounts Linux (ext4) and Windows (NTFS) drives on macOS with full read/write — no kernel extensions, no reboot. Native menu-bar app + CLI. Perfect for NAS disk recovery, dual-boot and retro handheld SD cards. One-time €9.99, open source (GPL-3.0).

records.name: Ledger
records.tagline: AI civic companion: cites the record, never a side
records.description: Ledger is an AI civic companion for a voting public that now gets its news from models. Most AI media steers. Ledger cites the public record and will not pick a side. Enter an address for the federal races on your ballot. Ask Vera — it answers from current official sources, then refuses an endorsement. A short values quiz orients without ranking. Daily polls are policy, not a feed. The aim is a better-informed voting class, not a hotter one.

records.name: Frutta
records.tagline: Your subscriptions, spending and renewals in one place
records.description: Track your subscriptions on iPhone and iPad with a clear monthly total, annual overview and upcoming renewals. Pick services from the catalog, then add your prices and dates. Sync through your own iCloud, without linking a bank account or creating another account. Five subscriptions are free; one purchase unlocks unlimited subscriptions. No ads or tracking.

records.name: Burning Bridges AI
records.tagline: Turn a photo into an AI party video
records.description: Burning Bridges AI combines editable party-scene prompts with photo-to-video and text-to-video workflows. Explore scene recipes, compare model settings, and work from your own photo or an authorized adult likeness. The site includes AI-generated visual demonstrations and an Image Studio.

records.name: TRN/LOG
records.tagline: The workout log that works out next week's weights
records.description: Log your sets and rate how they felt. TRN/LOG works out next week's weights, reps and sets from what you actually lifted, and every number comes with its reason. It's rules, not a black box: AI is optional and never picks a weight. Built for the gym floor: big targets for sweaty hands, plate math for your equipment, works offline in a basement. Missed a few weeks? It eases you back in. 14 days free, no card.

records.name: talktoregal.autos
records.tagline: Fims and Entertainment
records.description: Take the TalkToRegal.com Regal Survey and learn about the $100 Gift Card Sweepstakes, eligibility, survey steps, official rules, and how to share your feedback.

records.name: flipt.in
records.tagline: Discover unusually cheap international flights from India
records.description: Flipt helps Indian travellers discover unusually cheap international flight deals. Explore fares from major Indian cities, compare interesting destinations, and find affordable opportunities for your next trip.

records.name: EosLog
records.tagline: Field service software small crews can actually run
records.description: EosLog handles the office side of field work for small US service businesses. Schedule jobs and recurring visits, send quotes customers sign from a link, then invoice and get paid online. Time clocks per job show what each job actually made you. It also connects to AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT, so you can check the schedule or send an invoice from a chat. Web, iPhone and Android. Free for up to 20 clients, paid plans from $39/mo.

records.name: Larvabot
records.tagline: Find people already asking for what you sell
records.description: LarvaBot is your eyes across the internet. It monitors Reddit, X, Threads, Facebook, LinkedIn, forums and more to find conversations, leads and opportunities relevant to your business. Get alerts, discover prospects, generate personalized replies, track results, and uncover distribution opportunities. With BYOK, you bring your own API keys and free quotas, keeping usage costs low without per-lead or credit charges. The internet is talking. LarvaBot is listening.

records.name: MyPwdTool
records.tagline: Password manager, no account, security and privacy first
records.description: A free, end-to-end-encrypted password manager for macOS, iOS, Windows, and Android. No account, no cloud database, no tracking - your data, your devices. Password health, activity log, multiple vaults. Multi-device sync optional via affordable subscription.

records.name: The RainDance AI
records.tagline: Explore RainDance AI videos, demos and photo guides
records.description: Explore the RainDance AI trend through a fictional two-character coastal demo and practical photo and role guides. The site explains how to prepare portraits for a private, silent video workflow and shows one-time credit pricing. Video generation availability is still being prepared.

records.name: slideshow.is
records.tagline: Your guests' photos, live on the big screen. No app needed.
records.description: slideshow.is is a live photo wall for weddings, parties and company events. Guests scan a QR code and post photos, videos and messages from their phone's browser, and everything plays on any TV or projector within seconds. After the event, everyone opens the same link to see the full album. Download every photo in one zip, turn the album into a printable poster, or keep the whole slideshow to play offline.

records.name: LeMoine Group
records.tagline: One less thing for Entrepreneurs
records.description: LeMoine Group builds and sells ready-to-launch websites and digital products for developers, entrepreneurs, and businesses. Explore projects that include functional websites, applications, branding, and other assets, depending on the package. Our goal is to give builders a head start by providing digital projects they can acquire, customize, and develop in their own direction.

records.name: CheckedName
records.tagline: Find a domain name you can actually use.
records.description: Discover your next domain from a curated catalogue of names ready to register. Browse categories tailored to startups, SaaS products, developer tools, and more.
