Find a name that fits your idea, check availability, and secure your domain in seconds. You can also search for custom domains or generate fresh name ideas with CheckedName.

records.name: BeenThere
records.tagline: Safety-first travel network for solo & female explorers
records.description: After finishing #15 on Product Hunt in May, we built the official BeenThere iOS app from scratch! Most travel apps tell you where to go, but never how safe the neighborhood is. BeenThere brings real peace of mind: • Street-level Community Safety Index • Real-time in-app safety alerts as you explore • Dedicated ratings for solo & female travelers • Honest highlights, lowlights & scam precautions • Peaked at #33 in Travel on App Store in 24 hours! Free on iOS. Know before you go. Stay Safer.

records.name: AutoDiag
records.tagline: OBD-II error codes and engine codes for mechanics
records.description: AutoDiag is a practical offline tool for mechanics. It includes the most common OBD-II error codes with causes, symptoms and diagnostic steps, plus engine codes from the vehicle registration document (P.5 field). For each engine code it shows the main car models and recommended timing tools with purchase links. It also has a local AI assistant to help interpret codes quickly. No subscription required.

records.name: Home Cooked
records.tagline: Create and share cookbooks from your family recipes
records.description: Home Cooked is a book-first recipe platform for organizing the recipes you actually cook. Create personal cookbooks, import recipes, share entire books with friends and family, and keep meal planning and grocery lists in one place. It’s designed to make recipes feel less like scattered files and more like something worth keeping, sharing, and passing down.

records.name: DetectAI
records.tagline: Most accurate AI detector - 6 modes, free tier & no signup
records.description: Most accurate AI detector. Detects ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Quillbot, Undetectable AI in 2 seconds. 6 modes: Text, Video, Image, Document, Spreadsheet, Anti-Bypass. 3 free checks. Pro $9.99/month. Anonymous & 85-95% accurate.

records.name: ClientSummary
records.tagline: Turn GitHub commits into client progress reports using AI
records.description: ClientSummary connects your GitHub repositories and transforms raw commits into professional, client-ready Progress Proof Cards and milestone updates in seconds. Zero manual logging, automated AI summaries, multi-repo scoping, and effortless sharing for developers and freelancers.

records.name: Fontify AI
records.tagline: Turn text into stunning custom fonts with AI
records.description: Fontify AI is an AI-powered typography tool designed to help creators, designers, and marketers generate unique custom fonts effortlessly. Key Features: - Generate distinctive, creative fonts with simple text prompts - Instant live preview across multiple typographic styles - One-click font export ready for digital and print projects - 100% web-based with no complex design software required

records.name: Croptrove
records.tagline: Mac screenshots that hide card numbers before sharing
records.description: Croptrove is a macOS screenshot and screen recording app. An on-device privacy shield finds card numbers, IBANs and API keys so you can hide them before you share. No watermark in the free version; nothing is uploaded. Pro is $19.99 once.

records.name: Qynzo
records.tagline: AI voice agent & high-converting sites for real estate pros
records.description: Qynzo transforms static real estate websites into an active 24/7 sales engine. • 24/7 Voice AI (Nia): Answers inbound calls in natural voice, handles listing details, and books visits directly into Google Calendar. • FSBO Radar (Qynzo Scout): Finds for-sale-by-owner listings with direct phone numbers. • High-Speed Architecture: Built for sub-second speeds, automated local SEO, and instant CRM lead routing via webhooks. Everything an independent broker needs to scale without tech headaches.

records.name: flightschange
records.tagline: Same-Day Flight Changes: Rules, Fees, and Options Explained
records.description: Find airline flight change policies, fees, fare rules, and options. Understand what may apply before changing your flight or itinerary.

records.name: rungeist
records.tagline: Never wonder what's running on your Mac again
records.description: Rungeist is a Mac menu bar app for developers, AI builders, product managers and designers. It shows every dev server, port and Docker container on your machine, grouped by project, with live CPU and RAM. Open, restart or kill any of them in one click or from the keyboard. Unlike lsof or Docker Desktop, local processes and containers sit in one list. No telemetry. Free download, one-time purchase.

records.name: Pieces — Your Closet Portfolio
records.tagline: Your clothes, sneakers and watches as one portfolio
records.description: Pieces is an iPhone collection tracker for clothing, sneakers, bags, watches, jewelry and collectibles. Add photos or supported product links, record purchase costs, organize closets, review available market evidence and build shareable P&L cards. Keep wanted pieces in a wishlist. Market values are informational estimates, not appraisals or guaranteed sale prices.

records.name: Trinetra
records.tagline: Self-hosted server monitoring in one ~12 MB daemon
records.description: One small Go daemon per Linux server: live dashboards, 30 days of history, alerts to Telegram, Slack, Discord, email, ntfy or a webhook. Add a web UI with passkey sign-in, a public status page, and fleet mode with one join token. Self-hosted, no cloud.

records.name: SlapScroll
records.tagline: Slap your MacBook to skip to the next reel
records.description: A free menu bar app that turns your MacBook's hidden motion sensor into a "next reel" button. Tap the case or the desk - SlapScroll skips the TikTok, Reel or Short in your browser. No mic, no tracking.

records.name: DocForge
records.tagline: Turn HTML templates and JSON into PDFs with one API call
records.description: DocForge turns an HTML template and JSON data into a PDF or PNG. Design in the browser editor, start from 11 ready templates, and render from your code or from n8n, Zapier, Make and Activepieces. 100 free pages a month, then one-time packs that never expire.

records.name: Fable — More than a plan
records.tagline: Everything it takes to make it happen.
records.description: Fable is built for outcomes, not endless planning. Tell it what you want to make happen, and it creates a living Space around that goal. As real life moves forward, decisions are made, bookings confirmed, plans changed. Fable connects the pieces, understands what they mean, and shows you where things stand and what needs to happen next. Because making progress shouldn't mean spending more time updating the tools meant to help you.

records.name: English Grammar Hub
records.tagline: Step-by-step school English grammar in 3 languages
records.description: English Grammar Hub is a structured, step-by-step educational platform designed for school students (grades 3–11), teachers, and self-learners. Key features: - Grammar paths aligned with school grades and CEFR levels (A1 to C2). - Trilingual UI: switch between English, Kazakh, and Russian effortlessly. - An interactive 4-minute diagnostic test to quickly check your level. - Daily grammar highlights, practical exercises, and tests. Perfect for independent studies or as a supportive teaching tool!

records.name: AlphaScout: Discover Startups Early
records.tagline: Find startups early across 200+ sources in 50 countries
records.description: AlphaScout helps VCs, angel investors, family offices and startup scouts discover emerging companies early. It monitors 200+ sources across 50 countries, surfaces early-stage startups, ranks discoveries and links each result to its original source so you can verify signals and assess fit with your investment thesis. Spend less time searching scattered websites and more time evaluating relevant opportunities. Try AlphaScout free for 48 hours and share what would make it more useful.

records.name: UnFight: Couples & Marriage
records.tagline: Take a break, check in weekly, and say it right
records.description: UnFight is a private, self-guided toolkit for couples. Take a Break offers a 5, 20 or 30 minute timer, a private reminder and an editable message in your own words; nothing is sent for you. The weekly check-in covers one appreciation, one topic, one practical step and one thing to look forward to. Say It Right helps draft an apology or a boundary in a Brief, Gentle or Direct tone. Writing stays on your iPhone. Not therapy or emergency help.

records.name: The Lost 'N Found
records.tagline: Check if your email leaked or a text is a scam. Its Free!
records.description: One search checks your email, username, phone and domains for data breaches, exposed services and look-alike domains, then gives you a score and a fix list. Also a free scam-text checker and free security tools that run in your browser, so nothing is uploaded

records.name: oxi
records.tagline: The native coding agent for any model
records.description: Open-source desktop coding agent in Rust. Run local GGUF models (oxi installs llama-server for you), Ollama or LM Studio, or bring your Claude Code, Codex or Cursor subscription. Diff editor, Git, terminal and plan mode in one ~110 MB binary.

records.name: ResizeImage.app
records.tagline: Free image resizer that never uploads your photos
records.description: Free image size reducer and picture size converter. Resize image resolution in pixels, by percent or to an exact KB size. Private: photos never leave your device.

records.name: Correxio
records.tagline: AI grading for handwritten exam papers, reviewed by you
records.description: Correxio grades handwritten exam papers with AI, against your own rubric. Student names are masked first, then each paper gets a score per question and annotations on the scan. You review, adjust in one click and export. Free plan available.

records.name: BuildBridge
records.tagline: Post your home project free — get GTA tradespeople quotes
records.description: BuildBridge is an online marketplace connecting homeowners and businesses across the Greater Toronto Area with verified local tradespeople. Post your job in under 2 minutes — plumbers, electricians, HVAC techs, painters and more. Every trade is licence/WSIB/insurance-verified, every quote is transparent, and every job can be reviewed. Free to post at https://buildbridge.ca

records.name: Bombitup
records.tagline: Bombitup is a fun and Fake Sms App
records.description: BombitUP is an Android app for SMS, call, and email testing and fun. Explore BombitUP APK, online features, latest 2026 updates, and safe ways to enjoy its testing tools.

records.name: AyCode
records.tagline: A calm desktop workspace for coding agents
records.description: Run Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Grok and more side by side, with your Obsidian vault as their second brain. Free for Mac (Apple Silicon, Developer ID signed and notarized), Windows, and Linux (beta). Your own subscriptions stay yours. English UI available.

records.name: RowDex
records.tagline: A native database client for SQL, Redis, Mongo & BullMQ
records.description: RowDex replaces pgAdmin, Redis Insight, Bull Board, and Compass with one native app. Connect Postgres, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite, Redshift, MongoDB, and Redis — plus a BullMQ queue monitor built into your Redis connection. Built with Tauri, not Electron: under 50MB to install, under 60MB idle RAM. Optional AI assistant drafts read-only SQL from your schema; you confirm before anything runs. Free forever on Basic, no account needed to download.

records.name: KYB - Shared Memory for AI Agents
records.tagline: Shared memory for AI agents, backed by Git
records.description: Give Claude Code, Codex and other agents one shared knowledge base. KYB stores readable Markdown in Git, keeps version history, and combines keyword and local semantic search. Self-hosted, open source, with a CLI and MCP interface.

records.name: NatureHue
records.tagline: Capture nature colors for your designs. Free, no signup
records.description: Hi, Subodh here! I built NatureHue to turn nature photos into pro palettes instantly. No tracking, no accounts, 100% private on your device. Other tools charge up to ₹2,000/mo, but this is completely free forever. I earn zero money, just building to serve the design community honestly. Try it out! Capture exact colours from any nature photo and use them in your designs. Free, no login. An original concept by Subodh Purushottam Zare.

records.name: Relaymote
records.tagline: Your Claude Code desktop sessions, live on your phone
records.description: Open-source (MIT) remote for Claude Desktop's Code tab. Pair your phone by QR and see every session as the desktop does: the same session, not a copy. Reply or approve prompts from anywhere. Auto-resumes after usage limits. Windows; macOS experimental. Unofficial; not affiliated with Anthropic.

records.name: Pixel Up
records.tagline: AI photo upscaler and restorer that keeps faces real
records.description: Pixel Up fixes photos in one click: upscale to 2x (up to 4800px), restore old prints, colorize black-and-white photos, sharpen blur, enhance faces and remove scratches or objects. Built to recover detail, not repaint it — your faces stay yours. In-browser.

records.name: CamStory: GPS Photo & Notes
records.tagline: GPS Camera, Photo Notes & Location History
records.description: CamStory is a GPS camera and photo documentation app that helps you capture photos with location, notes, people, memories, date, time, and GPS information. Whether you are traveling, documenting a site, recording a special moment, or simply want to remember where a photo was taken, CamStory keeps the important details together. GPS Camera and Location Photos Remember the Story Behind Every Photo Find Your Photos and Notes Explore Photos on the Map Digital Compass and GPS Tools Create PDF Reports

records.name: TubeVoice
records.tagline: AI dubbing for videos and games in 67 languages
records.description: TubeVoice dubs YouTube, Shorts, Reels and TikTok videos (or your own file up to 2 GB) into 67 languages with natural AI voices, keeping the music and sound effects. You get a dubbed MP4 plus subtitles. It can also remove the voice and keep the music, and GameVoice, a Windows app, dubs games into your language. 15 free credits, no card, no subscription.

records.name: seodata.dev
records.tagline: Real search volume for Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor
records.description: seodata.dev gives AI assistants real keyword data. Paste one MCP URL into Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor and your assistant can look up monthly Google search volume, CPC and competition for any keyword in 50+ countries, plus similar keywords with their own volumes. It works before you sign up with 20 lookups a day, a free key gives 500 a month, and Unlimited is $4.99 a month. The same key works with a plain REST API.

records.name: TasklyFamily.app
records.tagline: TasklyFamily.app: Gamified chore app for homes
records.description: TasklyFamily.app turns daily household chores into an engaging game for families, couples, and roommates. Spin the task roulette, earn XP, build streaks, and claim rewards together!

records.name: Binary Options Trading Platform
records.tagline: Custom Binary Options Platform & Real-Time Trade Processing
records.description: We develop custom binary options trading platforms with server-side expiry validation and synchronized trade settlement logic to maintain consistency between trade records and outcomes. Our development process focuses on backend architecture, reliable transaction processing, and platform stability under concurrent trading activity. We help businesses build trading software aligned with their operational requirements and long-term business objectives.

records.name: LingQi
records.tagline: Ancient Chinese wisdom and AI for life's decisions
records.description: LingQi turns a question into a moment of reflection. Cast 12 Heaven, Human, and Earth pieces, then explore a Ling Qi Jing-inspired reading with AI-guided insights on your situation, possible trends, actions, and cautions. On iOS and Android.

records.name: Accelerator AI by Lovie.co
records.tagline: Answer once. Apply to 40 accelerators on your Mac.
records.description: Accelerator AI is half of FreeTools, a native Mac app. Answer 138 fields about you and your company once, then let the app fill in applications to 40 accelerators, 1,632 form fields between them, in its own browser, on your machine. Nothing is submitted until you press Submit.

records.name: Music Dawn
records.tagline: A recorder for musicians. Every idea sounds finished.
records.description: Music Dawn is a recorder made for musicians. Record an idea in one tap, hear it with a finished sound right away, and keep every take in one library on all your devices. iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch. Free, with optional Pro.

records.name: GrocerEase
records.tagline: Turnkey grocery store with real-time Telegram bot alerts
records.description: GrocerEase is a modern full-stack grocery & e-commerce web application built for seamless store management. Key Highlights: - Instant real-time order alerts sent directly to admin via Telegram Bot - Multi-tier checkout supporting Cash on Delivery & Mobile Banking - Protected admin dashboard for orders and inventory control - Clean, responsive UI optimized for quick shopping Ready to deploy for local businesses or commercial acquisition!

records.name: Agent Middleware
records.tagline: Permits and signed receipts for AI agent tool calls
records.description: Agent Middleware sits in front of MCP tools. Agents act under a permit; a same-key retry returns the original receipt, no second call or charge. Calls outside the permit are refused before any charge. Every receipt is Ed25519 signed and verifiable offline.

records.name: Adastra.you
records.tagline: Polish astrological app with personal forcasts
records.description: Adastra.you is an app created by a real astrologer. It respects user privacy not sharing any data with 3rd parties (no meta pixel or technologies). It offers free access without need to provide credit card details. No agressive marketing, no emotional blackmail. You check what it offers for free and decide if you want more.

records.name: Oh My Focus
records.tagline: Dim other monitors until you're ready to switch
records.description: Oh My Focus keeps the monitor under your cursor clear and dims the rest. Adjust each screen's dimming and switch when you're ready. Free on the Mac App Store for macOS 14+.

records.name: Arqam360
records.tagline: Cookie consent for Gulf websites, in Arabic and English
records.description: Consent software for Gulf SMB websites: a native Arabic/English right-to-left banner, Google Consent Mode v2 denied until the visitor chooses, and an exportable consent log. Apps for Shopify, Zid and WordPress, or we install it. Free for one domain.

records.name: PujoRoute
records.tagline: Offline pandal-hopping guide for Kolkata's Durga Puja
records.description: 487 pandals, one-tap route planning, Metro guidance, the Panjika and emergency numbers, all working offline when the Pujo crowds jam the network. Free, with no sign-up.

records.name: Fraya
records.tagline: The design-first commerce OS for small businesses
records.description: Fraya is a design-first commerce OS for small businesses. Describe your business in one sentence and Fraya designs the website, builds the store and connects checkout to your own Stripe. Then it drafts the week: social posts, email campaigns, review requests and a note on what sold. Nothing goes out without your yes. It replaces ten separate tools, and every site is built so AI search can read it. Free to publish and sell, 1% on sales. Paid plan $29/mo.

records.name: Pani
records.tagline: Your weekly meals and grocery list from one sentence
records.description: Type one sentence like "two of us, 50 euros" and Pani plans a week of meals within your budget, builds the grocery list sorted by aisle and shows an estimated total before you reach the checkout. If the budget is too tight, it tells you upfront and suggests options. It also cooks around what's left in your fridge. Free, no ads, no account. French-only for now (prices from French stores, shown as estimates).

records.name: Vitrina Engine
records.tagline: Uptime, SSL, DNS and blacklist monitoring
records.description: Uptime, SSL, DNS, blacklist and server monitoring with status pages, on-call and per-client workspaces. Free plan, then $7 a month.

records.name: QuitGPT
records.tagline: Stack Overflow but with close friends.
records.description: QuitGPT is AI-first developer Q&A. Ask programming questions, get instant AI answers, and verify them with the community.

records.name: Clarity Audit
records.tagline: Find UX friction before your visitors leave
records.description: AI-powered UX diagnostic that scans any website and predicts what your first visitor will do — before they bounce. Clarity score, heatmap, competitor comparison, and ready-to-paste fix prompts. No login. 60 seconds. 661 sites scanned, average score 42/100.

records.name: Halal & Healthy
records.tagline: Every food additive explained: origin, halal status, why
records.description: A free database of all EU food additives with their origin, halal verdict and reasoning, in 10 languages. Scan a barcode in the app or read any additive on the web. Built on Open Food Facts. No ads, no account, no tracking.

records.name: Pixel Budget
records.tagline: Take control of your money with zero-based budgeting
records.description: Pixel Budget puts privacy, flexibility, and simplicity first. No bank connections required — add transactions manually, with Siri, or by importing bank statements. Use it as a simple expense tracker or a complete budgeting tool, with Envelope or Zero-Based budgeting and a Budget Assistant that suggests monthly budgets automatically. Its clean, intuitive interface makes managing your money easy, whether you're on desktop or mobile.

records.name: Classroom Games
records.tagline: Free classroom games and tools, no sign-up needed
records.description: Bring lesson reviews, brain breaks and vocabulary practice to your classroom. Classroom Games offers 12 browser games for a projector or smartboard, 10 teacher tools and 87 game guides for K–12. Add your own questions, play in teams, or try a live quiz where students join on their phones. Free to use, with no account required.

records.name: Image to Text
records.tagline: Extract and translate text from images and webpages
records.description: Image to Text uses Google Lens OCR to extract editable text from images and selected webpage areas. Paste, upload, drag, or capture images to recognize text instantly. Translate text with Google Translate, display draggable translation cards, and switch between original and translated content. Edit, copy, and save up to 20 OCR results locally. Supports multiple languages and keyboard shortcuts. No account or API key required.

records.name: GHDraw
records.tagline: Free browser whiteboard: draw and collaborate, no signup
records.description: GHDraw is a free whiteboard that runs in your browser with no account. Draw shapes, arrows, emoji and sticky notes, use ready-made templates, open a live shared room and draw together, and export to PNG, GIF, MP4, PDF or SVG. It also has AI translate and spell-fix, works offline as a PWA, and the UI is available in English and Turkish. Open source on GitHub.

records.name: Pluto Budgeting
records.tagline: Manage your money the way you've always wanted to
records.description: Pluto is a budgeting app built around your cash flow, not last month's receipts. It automatically detects recurring bills, forecasts your balance day by day, and flags the moments you'll be tight so you can fix them early. Clean transaction data, clear runway, and space to save for what's next. Budgeting that looks forward.

records.name: PatentDrawing
records.tagline: AI Patent Drawing Generator
records.description: Create patent drawings from text, photos, sketches, or CAD screenshots. Generate line art, 3D perspective views, and flowcharts. Download high-resolution PNGs.

records.name: TryAgainText + FlirtFix
records.tagline: Better dating app replies on web and Android
records.description: Turn a dating app chat into three reply ideas that fit the conversation. Paste text or upload a screenshot, choose the situation, and edit the suggestion that sounds like you. TryAgainText works in your browser with two free generations and no account needed. FlirtFix brings the same idea to Android, with personalized openers from dating profiles, chat replies, saved conversations, and a blur tool for hiding sensitive parts of screenshots.

records.name: Accent Letters for Windows
records.tagline: 682 accented letters, one click away, on Windows
records.description: Typing an accented letter on Windows means remembering an Alt code — Alt+0233 for é — or digging through Character Map. Accent Letters is a free Windows app from the Microsoft Store. 682 accented letters, A to Z, each with its Alt code, keyboard shortcut and HTML entity. Click a letter to copy it. Search by the letter itself, by its Unicode name, by language, or in plain words: "two dots", "squiggle", "hat". Works offline. No account, no ads, no tracking.

records.name: Citeably
records.tagline: See where AI recommends your brand, or picks rivals.
records.description: When customers ask ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Perplexity what to buy, is your brand recommended? **Citeably** helps you find out. Enter your website to see where AI assistants mention your brand, your ranking, competing recommendations, and cited sources. It also audits your site's AI readiness, including robots.txt, llms.txt, and structured data, then provides ready-to-use fixes and a prioritized action plan to improve visibility.

records.name: haskie
records.tagline: Give AI coding agents the knowledge you trust.
records.description: haskie gives Codex and Claude Code a library of sources you trust: technical references, domain knowledge and examples that reflect your taste. Curate it through a simple UI. Your agents explore broadly, then dig into focused passages with citations and fewer repeats. Inspired by how humans research, this discovery–synthesis loop helps agents make decisions grounded in your knowledge. Runs locally, with one-command agent setup.

records.name: Unifyca
records.tagline: All your client websites. One workspace.
records.description: Managing client websites means juggling credentials, hosting, domains, documentation, backups, maintenance and monitoring across multiple tools. Unifyca brings everything together in one workspace. Built for web agencies, freelancers and developers, it helps you document, manage, monitor and maintain client websites, with powerful WordPress integration. Less scattered information. More control.

records.name: Video Delay
records.tagline: Watch your last rep hands-free, seconds after you do it
records.description: Prop up your iPhone or iPad, do a rep, and watch it back on a delay of 1 to 60 seconds. Video Delay keeps replaying while you practice. Save a rep, review it in slow motion or frame by frame, and draw lines or angles on the video. Use AirPlay or HDMI for a bigger view. Pay once, with no subscription, ads, or account. Your video stays on your device unless you choose to share it.

records.name: Simmerset
records.tagline: Plan the week's dinners and get one grocery list by aisle
records.description: Simmerset plans a week of dinners and writes one grocery list, sorted by aisle. Say who's eating, what they must never eat and how long a weeknight is, and you see three dinners before you sign up. An allergy takes a recipe out of every plan, and missing allergen data counts as containing it. Each line on the list shows which dinners need it. Use it on iPhone, Android or the web, free with no time limit. Leaving Mealime before October 21? Type the dinners you cooked there to find close matches.

records.name: Darji
records.tagline: Run your tailor shop: orders, measurements, QR receipts
records.description: Darji is a self-hosted web app for tailor shops and boutiques. Track every garment on an orders board from cutting to delivery, keep versioned customer measurements, print QR/barcode receipts customers can scan to track their order, and manage advances, dues, expenses, staff, fabric stock and reports. Built with Laravel + React: 10 languages including Arabic and Urdu (RTL), dark mode and a one-click web installer. A one-time purchase, and your data stays on your server.

records.name: Arbiline
records.tagline: Find crypto arbitrage spreads and trade both legs in a click
records.description: Arbiline is a crypto arbitrage scanner that also trades. One live table tracks price spreads and funding-rate gaps across 15+ exchanges and DEXes: Binance, Bybit, OKX, Hyperliquid, Lighter, Solana, Base and more. Every spread is priced from real order books with both sides' fees included. One click opens both legs through your own API keys. Protection watches every position, and an auto-trading bot enters and exits for you 24/7. The table is public, demo mode is free.

records.name: EraseKit
records.tagline: Select once. Remove the same object/logo from every image
records.description: EraseKit is an AI-powered object removal tool that lets you remove unwanted objects, people, and distractions from photos directly in your browser. Select an area once and apply the same edit across multiple images with batch processing. Your images are processed locally on your device, keeping editing private and simple. Download images individually or as a ZIP. Select once. Erase everywhere.

records.name: CloveDesk
records.tagline: The professional way to work with clients
records.description: Send quotes, collect signatures, share files, manage expenses related to projects and clients, invoice clients, and get e-signatures. An automatic invoice payment reminder option is also available for paid plans. All from one secure and branded portal. Clients log in with a magic link. No passwords, no friction.

records.name: Splice
records.tagline: Stop chasing your friends for your money. Get paid back.
records.description: Tired of texting friends to pay you back? Splice is here to save the day! Front the bill once and Splice charges everyone their own share and sends you the money. Friends join in under 30 seconds with no account and no app, and pay with Apple Pay, Google Pay, or a card. Perfect for rent, trips, dinners, and event tickets. Charge when you're ready, at a set time, or once enough people join. Everyone sees their exact share first and can pause to talk it over before their card is charged.

records.name: Omut
records.tagline: Telegram, WhatsApp and our own messenger in one app
records.description: Omut puts Telegram, WhatsApp and its own messenger into one native app for iPhone, iPad and Mac: one inbox, one search, one notification flow. Built solo in Tokyo, now in free open beta. New: long voice messages get a short summary powered by Claude (transcribed on your device). Coming next: two-way translation and turning "let's meet Friday at 7" into a calendar event.

records.name: ResumePass
records.tagline: Free ATS resume check + automated recruiter review per job
records.description: Free ATS resume check: a score out of 100 and what to fix. Have a job ad open? The recruiter review reads your resume against it, US$9.99 once: a fit verdict, graded requirements, interview questions, a 90-day plan for the role. No account, no subscription.

records.name: QualifyLoop
records.tagline: Turn B2B website visitors into booked meetings with AI
records.description: QualifyLoop identifies the companies on your site, qualifies visitors with an AI agent that books real meetings mid-chat, routes hot accounts to a rep, and syncs with HubSpot + Salesforce. A self-serve, usage-priced alternative to Qualified and Drift: free to start, one script tag.

records.name: Formalini V2
records.tagline: Developer Tools. Business. Document to Data. Earn with Us
records.description: Formalini is evolving beyond AI document extraction into a complete automation and developer platform. What's new? Browser-based DevOps, QA tools for accessibility audits, Playwright test generation, API testing and visual regression, alongside AI-powered document processing, reusable workflows and upcoming industry-specific Blueprints. One platform where businesses automate repetitive work and developers build, integrate and monetize solutions without juggling multiple tools. And a way to earn.

records.name: Voi Resume
records.tagline: Write your resume on the page. Download it free.
records.description: Most resume builders make you fill in forms, then put the download behind a paywall. Voi Resume lets you edit the page itself: click any line and type, and what you see is the PDF you get. Downloads are free and unlimited (PDF, Word, plain text), with no watermark and no card. Import your old resume, fit it to one page in one click, paste a job posting to see missing keywords, and check what applicant tracking systems read. Pro adds version history, a live resume link and a job tracker.

records.name: Squishly Tools
records.tagline: Free file tools that never upload your files
records.description: Squishly Tools is a free set of 39 file tools: compress and convert images, merge, split and shrink PDFs, compress video, pull MP3 audio from video, zip and unzip files, and clean up CSV and Excel data. Every tool runs inside your browser, so nothing is uploaded, and there is no sign-up or watermark. Available in 40 languages.

records.name: MailSenpai DNS Check
records.tagline: Free SPF, DKIM, DMARC and MX checker that tells you the fix
records.description: Check any domain's SPF, DKIM, DMARC and MX records in seconds and get plain-English fixes with the exact values to publish. Plus SPF and DMARC generators, an email header analyzer, an embeddable widget, a free JSON API and an MCP tool for AI assistants.

records.name: Taxi Basel Airport Service
records.tagline: Reliable Flate Rate Service
records.description: Traserbas offers reliable Taxi Basel Airport services for convenient transfers to and from EuroAirport Basel. Enjoy professional drivers, comfortable vehicles, door-to-door transportation, and fixed-rate pricing for journeys to Basel city centre, hotels, business destinations, and locations across Switzerland. Whether you need an airport pickup, a private taxi to Zurich Airport, or a chauffeur-driven transfer, Traserbas provides flexible travel solutions for business and leisure travellers.

records.name: Evolution Freedom Stock Tools
records.tagline: Free stock screener, dividend calendar and yield-trap check
records.description: Free browser tools for UK and US investors: stock and ETF screener, dividend calendar, yield-trap check, income ETF score, ETF overlap, DRIP backtest and compare. No account needed. Try Premium free for 7 days, no card, then £6.99/month. Not financial advice.

records.name: Archive Tunes
records.tagline: Discover and listen to music from the Internet Archive.
records.description: Search and stream free music from the Internet Archive: classical, jazz, rock, live recordings and 78rpm records. No sign-up, no ads.

records.name: OmniTools AI
records.tagline: Smart financial calculators & AI productivity tools
records.description: OmniTools AI is a fast, multi-utility web suite designed for everyday tasks. It features accurate financial calculators (Loan EMI and Mutual Fund SIP calculators) with instant partner breakdowns, AI-powered tools, and productivity utilities built with zero login friction.

records.name: Blossom Word Game
records.tagline: A free daily word puzzle that blooms in your browser
records.description: Blossom Game is a free daily word puzzle played right in your browser. Letters bloom around a flower — make as many words as you can from them, with a fresh puzzle every day. No download, no signup, just play. Try the blossom game at https://blossomgamez.com

records.name: Resume Craft
records.tagline: Free, local-first resumes with Markdown and live preview
records.description: Resume Craft is a free, open-source, local-first resume builder that combines Markdown editing with structured forms and instant A4/US Letter previews. Tailor resumes with bilingual templates, one-click Auto Fit, basic ATS-oriented checks, and PDF export. No account required. Your resume drafts stay in your browser, giving you more control over your content and privacy.

records.name: Sonicert
records.tagline: Check if a song is AI-generated — free, no signup.
records.description: Check a song for signs of AI generation. Upload audio or paste a supported link, see the score and detection signals, and inspect our public 26-track pilot results. Free single checks, no signup. Paid batch screening includes CSV export.

records.name: Lora
records.tagline: A running coach that changes your plan when you tell her
records.description: Most running plans hand you a schedule and expect you to follow it. Lora works the other way. Tell her your calves are tight or Thursday is gone, and she rewrites the week. She reads your watch data and coaches you by voice during the run. iPhone only.

records.name: EUDR Tools
records.tagline: Useful EUDR checks and map tools in one place
records.description: EUDR work usually means jumping between tariff codes, country risk lists and supplier map files. I built EUDR Tools to put those checks in one free place, in all 24 EU languages. It helps with preparation only. It does not certify compliance or file a DDS for you.

records.name: Komms
records.tagline: Voice AI agents you build as a flow, at 8¢ a minute
records.description: Build a phone agent as a flow of questions: one node per turn, typed answers (yes/no, numbers, dates, choices) route the call. Inbound, outbound and web chat from one script. $0.08 a talk minute all in, telephony included. 50,000 free tokens, no card.

records.name: JoliTools
records.tagline: Free online tools that run 100% in your browser
records.description: JoliTools is a set of free online tools, including image compressors, PDF tools, QR generators, calculators and more, that run entirely in your browser. No sign-up, no file uploads, no watermarks. Your files never leave your device, and new tools ship regularly.

records.name: Open Autofill
records.tagline: Fill any form in one click. Stop retyping. Start shipping.
records.description: Open Autofill is a free, open-source Chrome extension that autofills forms, generates realistic test data, and saves & replays filled forms. 100% local.

records.name: BechShop
records.tagline: Streetwear for people who hate fake positivity
records.description: Shop graphic T-shirts, hoodies and streetwear with dark humor and attitude. Discover original BechShop designs including MIFF, Be A Man and Digital Fatigue.

records.name: New Drugs
records.tagline: Made in New England
records.description: New Drugs, made in New England, is a social experiment that aims to make your life better instead of aiming to make money. Its like Twitter X Bumble BFF X ChatGPT X logcal. Share what you’re up to and make plans. Use responsibly.

records.name: WE'RE LAUNCHING GOSYRIA.NET!
records.tagline: GoSyria - Connecting Syria to the World
records.description: We’re excited to introduce **GoSyria.net** — a new travel platform built to make discovering and planning your next journey easier, simpler, and more convenient. ✈️ **Search and compare flights** from multiple travel providers. 🌍 **Explore travel possibilities** and find options that fit your plans. 💻 **Enjoy a simple, convenient experience** designed to help you plan with confidence. Whether you're travelling to visit family, explore, or plan your next adventure, **GoSyria is here for you.**

records.name: PostingClips
records.tagline: AI short videos, auto-posted to 9 social networks
records.description: PostingClips helps small businesses stay active on social media without the time drain. Describe a clip in one sentence and AI makes a vertical video, or use free library footage or your own clips. Edit in the free editor, then post to TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Threads, Snapchat and Bluesky with a separate caption per account. Plan everything in a calendar or turn on Automate to create and post new clips on schedule. Pay-as-you-go credits that never expire.

records.name: PureSEO
records.tagline: 31 free SEO & web tools, no signup, no limits
records.description: PureSEO is a collection of 31 free tools for SEO, content and web development: a 301 redirect generator forhtaccess, Nginx and PHP, an image optimizer and WebP converter, an SEO word counter with keyword density, an XML sitemap generator with a built-in crawler, a JSON-LD schema generator, a broken link checker and more. No signup, no limits, and most tools run entirely in your browser so your files never leave your device.

records.name: Copytrove
records.tagline: Private Mac clipboard manager. Pay once, not monthly
records.description: Copytrove keeps what you copy — text, links, images, files, code — in one searchable shelf on your Mac. Sensitive data is masked, nothing is uploaded, no account needed. Free to start; Pro is $19.99 once, not a subscription.

records.name: Dropvi
records.tagline: Send large files free, end-to-end encrypted, no sign-up
records.description: Dropvi sends files of up to 50 GB free, and nobody needs an account to send or receive. Every file is encrypted in your browser before it uploads, so our servers only ever hold ciphertext. Recipients get an ad-free page with previews of video, audio, images and documents. Pro adds 200 GB transfers, 30-day links, passwords, download limits and your own subdomain.

records.name: GaugeReel
records.tagline: Put speed, heart rate & your GPS route on action-cam video
records.description: GaugeReel turns ride, run, ski and track-day data into animated gauges for your video. Import GoPro GPS straight from the MP4, or pair DJI, Insta360 or phone footage with a FIT/GPX file from Garmin, Strava or Apple Watch. Line it up, style the gauges, export a transparent layer or a finished video. Free plan: no watermark, no account, no time limit. Basic adds Strava import, maps and 60 fps. Mac & Windows; your files stay on your computer.

records.name: WaterSheep
records.tagline: The open-source alternative to Jev
records.description: WaterSheep answers yes/no, choice, rating and multi-label questions about text, with a probability for every option. It takes Jev's API requests, so TypeSafe's own Python SDK works with it after a one-line change. Open weights, Apache 2.0, free.

records.name: Thetaxio
records.tagline: Finance back office for property and multi-entity firms
records.description: Thetaxio is a financial operations platform for property and multi-entity businesses: accounting, invoice OCR, bank reconciliation, reporting and a white-label client portal for Australia, New Zealand and the UK.

records.name: Latest Anime On KISSANIME
records.tagline: Kissanime – Discover Anime and Browse Anime Titles
records.description: Explore anime with Kissanime. Search for anime by title or browse the anime collection to discover your next series and new stories.

records.name: ClearTM
records.tagline: Affordable trademark watch for the other 95%
records.description: Corsearch and CompuMark cost $5,000+/month with a mandatory sales call — built for enterprise portfolios, not solo attorneys or small brand owners. ClearTM is self-serve: $20-49/month, no sales call. Weekly scans across USPTO, EUIPO, WIPO and 70+ offices, with alerts sorted by opposition-deadline urgency — not a raw filing dump

records.name: ReverseTarget
records.tagline: Turn any goal and deadline into calendar tasks
records.description: Enter a goal, what reaching it will feel like, and a deadline. ReverseTarget's AI works backward into daily, weekly or monthly tasks with three clear steps each, and exports them as calendar files you can import into Google, Apple or Outlook. Free for up to 24 tasks.

records.name: ProfileFindly
records.tagline: Social media finder
records.description: Search publicly indexed social profiles by name, niche, or location. Explore creators and businesses with ProfileFindly's social media finder.

records.name: OneRosta — scheduling for support teams
records.tagline: Simple 24/7 shift scheduling for remote support teams
records.description: Lightweight 24/7 shift scheduling for remote support teams and e-commerce stores. Catch coverage gaps before they happen, eliminate timezone calculation errors, and manage shifts without messy spreadsheets. Try our demo: www.onerosta.com/demo

records.name: Callspark
records.tagline: Every missed business call gets a text back in 15 seconds
records.description: Callspark is a done-for-you missed call text-back service for small businesses that run on inbound calls — real estate, mortgage, home services, trades, and more. Most “missed call” tools are self-serve software you configure yourself. Callspark is fully set up for you — custom messaging, your branding, your workflow — live within 48 hours. When a call goes unanswered, a personalized text fires back in 15 seconds. No app, no learning curve, no contracts. Just recovered leads.

records.name: Moji Vibe Animation
records.tagline: Create motion graphics without learning animation
records.description: Moji makes motion graphics approachable for people who have ideas but haven’t learned animation software. Start with a creative brief, then shape the result in your browser by adjusting text, colors, timing, and media. Preview your work and export a video for a product launch, social post, presentation, or campaign.

records.name: Brud Code
records.tagline: Your clipboard is the API key: free AI coding agent
records.description: Most AI coding agents need a paid subscription or API key. Brud Code doesn't. Use the free web tiers of ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini (or local Ollama models) as an agent inside VS Code. Paste the AI's instructions and Brud previews the diff, applies multi-file edits, runs commands with live terminal output, and lets you roll back with local snapshots. 100% free and open source. No subscription, no API key. You shouldn't have to code slowly just because you can't afford an API key.

records.name: Vibes'n'Feels
records.tagline: An emotion map of moments and places
records.description: Vibes'n'Feels is an emotion map for moments, places and feelings. Capture a fresh photo or a video of up to 20 seconds, pair it with a place and a feeling that fits the moment, then keep the Vibe Personal or share it temporarily with Friends or Everyone. Explore Vibes through Map and Feed, support one with Feel and open its Discuss while it is live. Friends sharing lasts up to 3 days. Everyone lasts 24 hours. No follower counts, public profile histories, popularity rankings or direct messages.

records.name: SecretUXD
records.tagline: AI UX Intelligence Platform
records.description: Run an AI UX audit in under a minute. SecretUXD checks your site against Nielsen heuristics, Laws of UX and WCAG 2.2 AA, with evidence and code fixes.

records.name: Blue Proxy Browser & WebProxy
records.tagline: Fast web proxy & secure Android browser with ad-block.
records.description: A privacy-focused suite featuring a lightning-fast web proxy powered by Node.js, and a dedicated Android browser utilizing native VpnService, DoH/DoQ encryption, and built-in ad mediation for an unrestricted, secure browsing experience.

records.name: Word Ward
records.tagline: Drag & connect letters to solve daily themed word puzzles
records.description: Word Ward is a drag-and-connect word puzzle game where you form words by connecting letters on a grid. Play daily themed puzzles and compete on a global leaderboard across 21 languages. Earn gold, use jokers, unlock themes, and remove ads. Fresh challenges every day. Free with optional in-app purchases.

records.name: TidyMate
records.tagline: Messy files. Sorted. Automatic file organizer for Windows
records.description: TidyMate (formerly Everjoe Folder Organizer) is a Windows 10 and 11 app that sorts messy Downloads, Desktop and Documents folders in seconds, files invoices and bank statements by what's inside them (Smart Rules), and organizes new downloads automatically (Watch Folders). 100% on your PC. Preview first, undo anytime. Free plan. Made in Nigeria by Everjoe.

records.name: Kiji - Tasks, Notes & habits
records.tagline: Todo list, planner & kanban
records.description: Hey everyone! 👋 I'm an indie developer and I'm excited to share Kiji, a productivity app I've built with lots of love. ❤️ Kiji brings tasks, notes, and habit tracking together in one place, helping you stay organized without feeling overwhelmed. Available on iPhone, iPad, and Mac, it's designed to make everyday productivity simple and enjoyable. I'd love for you to give it a try and share your honest feedback! 🚀 Try Kiji: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/kiji-tasks-notes-habits/id6806329195

records.name: hidane
records.tagline: A Firestore emulator without Java, in one Rust binary
records.description: hidane replaces the official Cloud Firestore emulator with a single Rust binary: no JDK, a 5.5 ms start, 7.4 MiB idle. It speaks gRPC, REST and WebChannel, enforces Security Rules, and runs under firebase-tools, where Firestore-triggered Cloud Functions fire as with the official emulator (new in v0.4). Parity is measured, not claimed: hidane's tests replay 20,224 answers recorded from the official emulator, and firebase-js-sdk's own browser suite passes.

records.name: Realust
records.tagline: The nutrition label for North Texas cities
records.description: Moving to Dallas? Realust scores all 84 cities in Collin, Dallas, Denton and Rockwall counties on 288 data points each: schools, safety, home prices, commute, growth and more. Every city is scored the same way, from the same sources. Compare cities side by side, re-rank them with your own priorities, or take an 8-question quiz to find your match. Built by a local former architect who thinks choosing a city deserves better data than choosing a kitchen. Free to use.

records.name: POOP LAUNCHER
records.tagline: Aim your butt. Blast the poop. Knock ’em all away.
records.description: A silly, satisfying physics shooter that runs right in your browser. Aim a butt cannon, fire normal, loose, or giant poop, and knock a stack of poop off the table. Chain reactions, combo callouts, and EN/JP support. No download, no sign-up.

records.name: Wishorium
records.tagline: Family wish lists kids flick through like a toy catalogue
records.description: Add toys and gifts from any shop (or import an Amazon list), share one link, and the family circle what they're buying, so nobody doubles up and the birthday child never sees who. Child mode lets kids browse and heart things. Free, no app for the family.

records.name: QuoteBack Follow-Up Generator
records.tagline: Free follow-up emails for contractors. No signup needed.
records.description: Sent a quote and heard nothing back? QuoteBack's free Follow-Up Generator helps contractors write a professional follow-up without staring at a blank email. Enter your trade, job details, quote amount, and how long it's been since you sent the estimate. Get a suggested follow-up schedule and ready-to-copy email drafts you can personalize. No account, payment, or subscription required. Nothing is sent automatically—you decide what to send and when.

records.name: Popotam
records.tagline: Free AI meal planner with a grocery list, no account needed
records.description: Popotam plans your lunches and dinners for a week or a whole month, around your diet, allergies, budget and cooking time, then builds the grocery list sorted by aisle. Every dish is checked against your diet by code, not just promised by AI. Shop at any store. Also: meal prep plans, a fridge raid search, calories from official nutrition tables, live sharing with your household, and a one-click import for Mealime users. Free, no account, no ads. Web and Android.

records.name: Age Calculator by FreeWWW
records.tagline: Your exact age, plus fun facts about your life
records.description: A free age calculator that does more than count years. Enter your birth date to get your exact age in years, months and days, plus the total days, weeks, hours and minutes you’ve lived. You also get a next-birthday countdown, your zodiac and Chinese zodiac sign, birthstone, the weekday you were born, your generation and life milestones. Check your age on any past or future date, copy results in one click, no signup needed.

records.description: Copse remembers everything you copy. Press ⌘⇧V in any app to search and paste text, links, code, images and files, even by the words inside screenshots. Paste Stack fills forms in seconds. Private and on your Mac. Free for 7 days, then $2.99 once.

records.name: Sengi Runners
records.tagline: Managed GitHub Actions runners from $0.003 a minute
records.description: Keep GitHub Actions; change where your Linux jobs run. Sengi provides managed Ubuntu 24.04 x64 runners with a fresh VM per job and 2, 4 or 8 vCPU. Connect a repository, then change its runs-on label. Rates are $0.003/$0.006/$0.012 per execution minute, rounded up per job; boot and teardown are not billed. Start cardless with 3,000 shared monthly standard-2-equivalent free minutes, weighted 1/2/4 by size. No subscription or monthly minimum.

records.name: Tactyn
records.tagline: The local AI agent cockpit for developers
records.description: Tactyn puts Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and OpenCode in one desktop cockpit, one project per tab. See at a glance which agent is waiting for you, track how much is left on each AI subscription, and let Maestro split big tasks across Git worktrees for your approval. It runs the official CLIs with the subscriptions you already have, and your code never leaves your machine. Available for Windows, with Mac in beta. Free plan, plus a paid Pro.

records.name: Munchable
records.tagline: Check if the food you buy is suitable for your gut condition
records.description: Scan a barcode. Get a clear Good fit, Caution, or Avoid answer for your gut, with the reasons behind it. Seven gut conditions, one scan. We do not use AI to score any products. We only use AI for OCR and that is it

records.name: Foresite
records.tagline: Privacy First Website Analytics
records.description: Foresite shows how people find and use your website without cookies, without storing IP addresses, and without following anyone across days or sites. Simple integration into your site with one line of code on any site builder. Unlimited sites and branded client dashboards, from $4 a month.

records.name: FleetFuel
records.tagline: "Stop fuel theft in your fleet with photo-verified logs"
records.description: Photo-verified fuel logging, monthly fuel analytics, and secure owner–driver chat for fleets of Boleros, trucks, pickups and commercial vehicles. English, Hindi & Gujarati.

records.name: Skyad
records.tagline: Fly. Fight. Get sponsored.
records.description: Fly the weekly course. Top 10 pilots carry sponsor liveries.

records.name: ShiftRotations
records.tagline: Free shift rotation calendars and schedule tools
records.description: Free shift rotation calendars (24/48, 2-2-3, Pitman, DuPont) for your phone, plus a shift schedule maker, overtime and pay calculators. No sign-up.

records.name: Bolt by Sparcle
records.tagline: Local-first AI workspace, free for individuals
records.description: Bolt is a governed AI agent platform: free on the desktop, self-hosted for organizations. BYO LLM, MCP-native, PII masked at the LLM boundary.

records.name: Yolyc
records.tagline: Find and review real estate companies
records.description: Find and review real estate companies across the US and Canada. Browse brokerages, property managers, developers, lenders, and more on Yolyc.

records.name: SankeyFlow
records.tagline: The Sankey diagram maker built for the Mac
records.description: Write your flows as text, build them in a visual list, or paste a spreadsheet, and get a Sankey diagram. Show leftovers as Remainder boxes, then export PNG, PDF, or SVG. A native Mac app with no account; nothing leaves your Mac. $6.99.

records.name: WorldTimeCheck.world
records.tagline: Check time, plan meetings and travel across time zones
records.description: A free global time and timezone platform for checking local time, comparing cities, converting time zones, planning international meetings, and checking weather and public holidays worldwide. Built with IANA timezone data.

records.name: Meida
records.tagline: Puppet show of interest
records.description: U get to see art work and art work get to have your attention back and forth on your beloved website

records.name: ADL Solution
records.tagline: Native Salesforce integration, no middleware
records.description: ADL Connect is a Salesforce-native, no-code integration app, available on the Salesforce AppExchange, that syncs Salesforce with Jira, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Xurrent and Zendesk in real time.

records.name: CreatorOS
records.tagline: Your Creator Business. One Powerful Workspace.
records.description: The all-in-one creator & business monetization operating system: link-in-bio store, booking, courses, analytics, AI growth coach, email and more.

records.name: Visualiquid
records.tagline: Free Minecraft & Roblox creator tools
records.description: Browser-based 2D visual tools for Minecraft, Roblox, Stardew Valley, and Terraria creators.

records.name: Sharjeel Tahir – Free Online Tools
records.tagline: Free online tools for all — PDF, image, text & calculators
records.description: Free online tools hub by Sharjeel Tahir — PDF tools, image tools, text tools and calculators that run free in the browser with no sign-up and no usage limits. Built for students, freelancers and small businesses.

records.name: 6cm毛公仔鑰匙扣掛件製作訂製廠商
records.tagline: 毛公仔,毛公仔掛件,毛公仔廠商
records.description: 簡創是一家ISO9001:2015認證的毛公仔訂製工廠，BHCHK 6cm毛公仔鑰匙扣掛件製作訂製案例，歡迎在線獲取訂製報價。

records.name: StateDock
records.tagline: Agents come and go. Tasks remain.
records.description: Agents come and go. Tasks remain. A shared task home for your connected AI agents. Keep plans, decisions, progress, and delivery notes in one place. Continue the same work across agents, tools, and sessions. Open source · Self-hostable

records.name: Lyrics Overlay
records.tagline: Sing along while working, With accurate lyrics
records.description: I wanted to sing along to whatever I'm playing without keeping a lyrics tab open, so I built Lyrics Overlay. 🎵 It's a small Windows app that shows the lyrics for whatever is playing in your browser, on a karaoke-style strip that floats over every window. What it does: 🎧 Detects the song on its own. It works with YouTube Music, Spotify Web and YouTube in Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi.

records.name: Regulane
records.tagline: Regulations change. Stay ahead.
records.description: A register of regulatory change from RBI, SEBI, CERT-In and more that flags what names something you run, with ISO 27001 and DPDP Act compliance in one place.

records.name: JD Resume Review by AllthingsPM
records.tagline: See exactly where your PM resume falls short for one job
records.description: Upload your resume, pick or paste a product manager job description, and get a match score plus the gaps that matter: missing signals, weak bullets and skills the role asks for that your resume never shows. Comes with concrete rewrites, not just critique. One free review a day.

records.name: Qura Meet
records.tagline: Meet. Talk. Collaborate.With Ai
records.description: Secure, browser-based video meeting platform from Qura Technologies. Built in India for distributed teams worldwide with real-time live captions, searchable transcripts, and grounded AI meeting summaries. Free with no downloads.

records.name: DDR Rezepte
records.tagline: East German recipes, culinary history and a quiz
records.description: Rediscover East German cooking with DDR Rezepte for iPhone and iPad. Browse traditional dishes, read ingredients and cooking instructions, explore the stories behind the recipes, and try the DDR quiz. The app is permanently free to use. Developed independently by CK Goldapps.

records.name: LabelFixer
records.tagline: Shipping-label PDFs ready for 4×6 thermal printing
records.description: Prepare shipping-label PDFs in Chrome. Auto-crop, rotate and split labels from mixed PDF batches, review uncertain pages, then export one print-ready PDF. Processing stays on your device. Try 3 full-Pro Auto Fix runs without a card.

records.name: Nodetavi Macro
records.tagline: Visual Windows automation with nodes, recording & images
records.description: Build Windows workflows without coding. Connect visual nodes or record mouse and keyboard actions, then add image matching, conditions, and loops. Save JSON scripts and launch them with batch files. Runs locally with a browser-based editor. English/Korean UI.

records.name: ShareScout
records.tagline: Find what's overshared in Microsoft 365 before Copilot does
records.description: Read-only PowerShell + Graph audit of SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams sharing: Anyone links, sites open to every employee, stale guests, broken inheritance, ownerless sites, missing labels, with a per-site Copilot exposure score. Runs in your tenant. Nothing leaves it. The Lite tier is free and open source (MIT).

records.name: CrocoFile
records.tagline: Compress, convert & PDF any file at lightning speed.
records.description: Crocofile is a blazing-fast, all-in-one file toolkit for compression, PDF optimization, and document conversion. Compress PDFs, images, and files. Convert Word to PDF, Excel to PDF, and images to PDF. Or go the other way. No signup. No watermarks. No waiting. Built on edge infrastructure for speed and privacy. Your files never leave your browser. Try it free — see the difference speed makes.

records.name: Agentrium
records.tagline: One window for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Antigravity
records.description: Run Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Antigravity side by side. The native desktop home for developers who spawn many agent sessions at once.

records.name: Agent Readiness Toolkit
records.tagline: Audit how machine-readable your website or API is
records.description: Agent Readiness Toolkit is a free, open-source Python CLI that checks how machine-readable your website or API is. Scan technical signals, get evidence-backed scores, identify actionable fixes, compare changes, and add checks to CI. No API key or LLM required.

records.name: Dopamine
records.tagline: Keep your Mac awake with 0.0-nit display backlight cutoff
records.description: Next-generation macOS keep-awake utility with true zero-nit hardware backlight cutoff. Prevent clamshell sleep while protecting Liquid Retina screens and battery health.

records.name: Ollin
records.tagline: Plan it. Live it. Relive it. One app for the whole trip
records.description: Describe a trip in one sentence and get a real day-by-day plan. Plan it with everyone coming, book through partners with no Ollin fee, follow it on the ground with live flight status and reminders, then keep it as a recap. Free to start on iPhone, Android and the web.

records.name: PSTVue
records.tagline: Transform Education With AI Innovation
records.description: Web site created using create-react-app

records.name: Cozy
records.tagline: A private journal that stays yours
records.description: Cozy keeps your journal on your own device, as your own files you can open with anything. There's no Cozy server, and nothing is fed to AI.

records.name: Historai
records.tagline: Type any topic. Hear the story. Interrupt with questions.
records.description: Step into the past with history podcasts generated just for you. Choose any topic, hear the story, and ask questions along the way. Start exploring now!

records.name: GramForge
records.tagline: Describe your business, get a Telegram bot in a minute
records.description: Write a few sentences about your business. GramForge builds a chat assistant on your Telegram account that books clients into free slots, takes orders and payments, sends reminders and answers questions 24/7. Change it the same way — in plain words.

records.name: site de dicas de jogos
records.tagline: aqui tem varias dicas e um chat
records.description: aqui tem dicas de varios jogos e um chat

records.name: Shaloom — Live out your motto
records.tagline: Live your life as your motto - and we see it
records.description: A walk-through gallery for the scenes, art, and people you want to share.

records.name: Tally My Project
records.tagline: Free home project calculators that show their work
records.description: Free calculators for home improvement (concrete, tile, roofing, flooring), India real estate (home loan EMI, stamp duty, rent vs buy, property tax), and AI-generated house floor plans — no sign-up needed.

records.name: Super ToolKit
records.tagline: Free, 100% private in-browser digital tools & converters
records.description: Access 100+ free, private online tools on Super ToolKit. Convert MP4 to MP3, merge PDFs, enhance Dolby audio, and compress images with zero server uploads.

records.name: Start Using AI Today
records.tagline: Start Using AI Today
records.description: Not sure where to begin with AI? Here are 10 free tools with simple explanations, so you can pick one and try it on a real task today.

records.name: Ridemap
records.tagline: Let's ride!
records.description: Build, share and track interactive roadmaps. Plan the route, follow step-by-step learning paths and mark your progress.

records.name: ResmiAI
records.tagline: AI-Powered Resumes. Tailored to Every Job.
records.description: ResmiAI creates tailored, ATS-friendly CVs from your profile and any job description using AI. Generate a job-ready CV in one click.

records.name: ShipReady Metrics
records.tagline: Engineering health scores from the systems you already run
records.description: ShipReady Metrics reads your code, cloud and security tools through least privilege connectors and turns them into nine evidence based scores, one fix first vulnerability queue, and AI governance evidence. Source code is never stored. 14 day trial, no card.

records.name: SKAMMADRN Early Access
records.tagline: ARENA SPACE
records.description: An app made by https://hercules.app

records.name: WipeMark
records.tagline: The background remover that never hides your download
records.description: WipeMark cuts the background out of a photo, or erases something from it (a date stamp, an object, a random person in frame), and gives you the full file every time. Most free tools like remove.bg or Photoroom only let you download a tiny preview unless you pay. This one doesn't. No sign up, no watermark, no daily limit. The models run on my own server instead of your browser, so there's nothing to download and it works the same on any phone. Sponsors pay for the server, not you.

records.name: Preciprocal
records.tagline: AI-Powered Tools for Job Search and Career Preparation
records.description: Preciprocal helps job seekers prepare for recruitment with AI-powered resume analysis, ATS optimization, cover letter assistance, mock interviews, LinkedIn profile improvement, and job application tracking.

records.name: AIComics
records.tagline: Turn any story into a comic with AI
records.description: AIComics turns your story into finished comic pages. Write or paste a story and it drafts the chapter script, designs a consistent cast and draws every panel, complete with layouts, speech bubbles and sound effects. Then edit text and bubbles, regenerate any page, export, or publish to the community Gallery. 5 art styles in color or B&W. Free to start with 500 credits, packs from $0.99, no subscription, and you own what you make.

records.name: Work Smarter With Free AI
records.tagline: Work Smarter With Free AI
records.description: Cut your workload with 10 free AI tools for emails, documents, slides and research. Includes safety tips for using AI the right way.

records.name: nestd.ai
records.tagline: Turn property photos into listing descriptions with AI
records.description: nestd.ai analyzes your property photos and location to understand what makes each space unique — the light, the style, the feel, the neighborhood character — and turns that into listing copy ready to publish. No manual forms. No blank page. Upload images and get room-by-room descriptions, highlights, and insights. For agencies and portals: the same AI powers natural-language search — so guests and buyers can find properties by how they actually think, not by checkbox filters.
